6777402601.name: 大学学习笔记
6777402601.description: 这是一款不只是写完就结束， 而是可以制作“为了记住而写的笔记”的 学习型笔记应用。 这款笔记应用具备手写、键盘输入、荧光笔、通过标签切换笔记、添加表格、添加章节、计算器、添加便签、评论、通过添加右侧空白来扩展笔记空间、贴纸、图形、尺子、圆规等多种功能，同时还搭载了帮助之后牢牢记住内容的记忆功能。 它不只是把笔记整理得漂亮， 而是可以从“之后要怎样记住”反推，来制作笔记。 从课堂笔记、考试复习、讲义批注、PDF 学习，到制作记忆笔记。 为了拿到分数、掌握知识、制作之后还能用得上的笔记，这款笔记应用会支持你的学习。 如果你想做的不是“画画”，而是“学习”， 请一定试试这款笔记应用。 ◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆ 只有这款笔记才能实现的 4 种策略 ◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆ 在这款笔记应用中， 为了让写完笔记后更容易记忆， 推荐你用下面这些方式来制作笔记。 1. 用彩色笔写重要词句，然后之后记忆 用橙色或浅蓝色笔写下的重要词句， 之后可以使用记忆遮盖片，用颜色遮住并进行记忆。 无论是手写还是键盘输入都可以使用，是一种简单又方便的记忆方法。 顺便一提，长按遮盖片图标即可更改遮盖片的颜色。 2. 用荧光笔遮住重要词句，然后之后记忆 这是一种尤其适合图片和 PDF 记忆的实用方法。 只要事先用荧光笔标出重要部分，之后就可以将其涂盖起来进行记忆。 在记忆模式中，可以按不同荧光笔选择是否隐藏，因此也可以把强调

6778256831.name: 诗词山河
6778256831.description: 诗词山河是一款把中国古诗、历史地名与真实地图结合起来的诗词探索应用。 你可以在地图上浏览诗人笔下的山川、楼阁、古城与江河。每一个地点都以诗词数量标注热度，点击地点后，地图会聚焦到对应位置，并以竖排古诗的方式呈现作品内容，让诗句重新回到山河之间。 主要功能： 在地图上探索中国古诗相关地点 查看地点收录诗词数量与热度 点击地点后聚焦地图并展示古诗 竖排排版，还原更接近传统阅读的视觉感受 支持按地点查看多首相关作品 收录长安、庐山、黄鹤楼、滕王阁、赤壁、西湖、金陵、海南等诗词地理内容 诗词山河适合古诗爱好者、学生、教师、旅行者，以及希望用空间方式理解中国古典文学的人。 让古诗不只停留在文字里，也回到它所描写的山河。

6758838036.description: ALanWaker 是一款极简的局域网设备唤醒工具，让您轻松通过手机唤醒电脑、NAS 等支持 Wake-on-LAN 的设备。 【核心功能】 • 一键唤醒设备 • Siri 语音控制 • 长按图标快速唤醒常用设备 • 本地存储，保护隐私 【使用场景】 躺在床上语音唤醒电脑、快速唤醒工作站远程办公。 【简单三步】 添加设备（输入名称和 MAC 地址） 点击卡片唤醒 配置 Siri 快捷指令实现语音控制 支持 Windows/Mac/Linux 电脑、NAS、服务器等所有启用 Wake-on-LAN 的设备。

6780416387.description: 辩准是一款面向 iPhone 的专业发言计时工具，适合辩论赛、演讲比赛、毕业答辩、课堂展示、模拟法庭和路演发言等场景。 打开即可快速开始： 预设奥瑞冈、BP、演讲/答辩等常用赛制 支持创建、编辑、复制和保存自定义模板 分阶段倒计时，自动推进下一轮 30 秒、15 秒、5 秒提醒可配 支持声音、震动、全屏视觉提醒 支持大字号显示与屏幕常亮 最近使用模板一键继续 适合这些用户： 高中、大学辩手 辩论队主席、教练、计时员 演讲比赛参赛者 毕业答辩、求职路演、课堂展示用户 产品特点： 一次购买，无订阅 无广告 无需登录 本地保存模板和设置 比赛现场也能快速上手 如果你需要一个稳定、清晰、操作路径短的分段计时工具，辩准会比普通倒计时器更适合正式发言场景。

6779987526.name: Parchment: Agenda & Daily Note
6779987526.description: Parchment is a private daily journal that brings your writing, plans, calendar, and reminders together in one quiet place. It uses Apple's Reminders and the system calendar to bring your task and events together. Open today and start writing immediately. Your calendar events and due or overdue reminders can appear above your journal entry, giving you the context of the day without switching apps. Capture notes, reflect on what happened, plan what comes next, or use Parchment as a simple daybook for work and life. On iPad, Parchment also supports handwriting and drawing with Apple Pencil, so typed notes and handwritten thoughts can live together on the same day. Parchment is built for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with iCloud sync available through your private iCloud account. There is no Parchment account to create, no advertising, and no third-party analytics SDKs. Features include: Daily journal entries organized by date Calendar events shown alongside your writing Due and overdue reminders in your daily view Reminder completion from inside the app Apple Pencil handwriting and drawing on iPad iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac Widgets for a quick look at your agenda Shortcuts, Siri, and App Intents support Spotlight indexing for finding past entries Export tools for keeping a copy of your writing Custom appearance, fonts, and themes Parchment is for people who want a journal that understands the shape of their day. It gives you one place to write what happened, see what is coming up, and keep a private record over time.

6778044875.name: Workshop Planner: Shop Layout
6778044875.description: Workshop Planner helps you lay out your workshop, garage or shop to scale — so you know what fits before you move a single machine. Scan your room with LiDAR or enter the dimensions by hand, then drop in tablesaws, benches, storage and more as accurately-sized footprints. Every tool carries a real working-clearance zone, so you can see whether you've left room to actually use it. PLAN IN 2D Clean, top-down blueprint with grid and snap-to-grid Drag to move, pinch to zoom, drag corners to resize, two-finger rotate Working-clearance zones around every machine Doors, windows and roller doors on any wall Collision flagging when items or clearances overlap Live readouts: floor area, total footprint, item count Metric or imperial, accurate to the millimetre SEE IT IN 3D Interactive 3D view of your whole plan On LiDAR devices, your actual scanned room becomes the 3D shell Wall-mounted items and upper cabinets, using captured wall height BUILT FOR THE JOB A catalogue of common machines, benches and storage with sensible default sizes and clearances Add custom items at any size Note power type (240V/110V/3-phase), dust extraction and mobile bases Pin reference photos anywhere on the plan Export your plan to PDF or PNG to print or share Multiple saved projects PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud, no tracking — and no subscriptions. Pay once, plan forever. LiDAR scanning requires a device with a LiDAR scanner (iPhone Pro models and iPad Pro). Any device can plan a room by entering dimensions manually.

6670183766.name: WoodVerberator
6670183766.description: WoodVerberator is a convolution based reverb with some extra features : Reverb time can be set from 0 to 10s or to the IR file native length. Has controls to adjust the reverb (damping, distribution). Stereo can be created by either using a stereo IR file or by de-correlating a mono file or both. Has an HPF, LPF and saturator which work on the reverb late part (Tail) only, the early-late boundary can be set. Had Amplitude and Phase modulation which work on the reverb late part only, the early-late boundary can be set. Has Gating which can also be driven by the side chain. Has Ducking which can also be driven by the side chain. Has an extra Delay which works on the reverb late part only, the early-late boundary can be set. Has general HPF, LPF and De-Essing filters. Has a quality control to balance the CPU load. Has the standard Mix and Pre-Delay controls. User IR files can be tried and added to the WoodVerberator IR folder so they appear in the IR dropdown. Has Input and Output level meters. Has a graph displaying the IR.

6770832821.name: Sentium Glitch
6770832821.description: Build animated electronic instruments from four synthesis engines. Blend Subtractive, FM, Karplus-Strong, and Wavetable layers. Sentium Glitch is a stereo AUv3 synthesizer for producers, composers, and sound designers who want layered motion inside one focused instrument. Use it in compatible AUv3 instrument hosts, or open the standalone app on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro to load the same experience, connect MIDI inputs, and play it as a standalone instrument. Every patch is a complete sound design document: four engine layers, per-layer envelopes, filters, LFOs, modulation routes, pan, level, engine bypass, master effects, polyphony budgeting, voice mode and glide, and optional recorded XY Pad motion all recallable through presets and AU host project state. Core sound engines: Subtractive: dual oscillators, sub, noise, detune, pulse-width shaping, and multimode filtering for classic analog weight and layered fundamentals. FM: five operator topologies for bells, keys, metallic basses, and aggressive digital color: two-operator, blended two-operator, stacked, dual-modulator, and split-carrier. Karplus-Strong: plucked and struck delay-line resonators for guitars, kotos, mallets, metallic attacks, and hybrid acoustic-electric textures. Wavetable: curated morphing tables with vocal formants, digital edges, harmonic motion, seeded-random spectra, and unison width for animated modern tones. Performance and modulation: Poly, mono, and legato voice modes with adjustable glide (portamento) for tight monophonic basses and expressive, gliding leads. Two XY pads with four routable axes. Record XY pad motion per engine and save it with the patch. Route LFOs, envelopes, velocity, aftertouch, pitch bend, mod wheel, CC74, and XY pad axes to musical targets. Move oscillator pitch and mix, FM index and ratios, Karplus brightness and decay, wavetable position and detune, filter, pan, gain, LFO rates, and master-FX controls. Sync LFOs, chorus rate, and delay time to host tempo when available. Patch and mix tools: Four-layer engine mixer for balancing, panning, and bypassing each sound source. Master chorus, delay, reverb, level, and soft clip. Global polyphony budget up to 32 voices with device-aware runtime limits. Stereo output at 44.1, 48, and 96 kHz sample rates where supported. On-screen keyboard with pitch and modulation wheels, plus CoreMIDI input management in the standalone app. Factory and user library: Start from 92 factory presets spanning signature motion patches, classic synth tones, basses, leads, keys, bells, plucks, strings, pads, rhythmic textures, atmospheres, experimental sounds, and technical references. Save your own user presets locally with iCloud sync when available. Export selected saved user presets as .sgpresets files and import them through a preview workflow that appends new user presets without overwriting the existing library. Sentium Glitch is built for sounds that move: evolving pads, unstable digital bells, hybrid plucks, animated basses, cinematic sweeps, mono leads that glide between notes, and expressive performance patches that respond to your hands.

6770832821.summaryDescription: Build animated electronic instruments from four synthesis engines. Blend Subtractive, FM, Karplus-Strong, and Wavetable layers. Sentium Glitch is a stereo AUv3 synthesizer for producers, composers, and sound designers who want layered motion inside one focused instrument. Use it in compatible AUv3 instrument hosts, or open the standalone app on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro to load the same experience, connect MIDI inputs, and play it as a standalone instrument. Every patch is a complete sound design document: four engine layers, per-layer envelopes, filters, LFOs, modulation routes, pan, level, engine bypass, master effects, polyphony budgeting, voice mode and glide, and optional recorded XY Pad motion all recallable through presets and AU host project state. Core sound engines: Subtractive: dual oscillators, sub, noise, detune, pulse-width shaping, and multimode filtering for classic analog weight and layered fundamentals. FM: five operator topologies for bells, keys, metallic basses, and aggressive digital color: two-operator, blended two-operator, stacked, dual-modulator, and split-carrier. Karplus-Strong: plucked and struck delay-line resonators for guitars, kotos, mallets, metallic attacks, and hybrid acoustic-electric textures. Wavetable: curated morphing tables with vocal formants, digital edges, harmonic motion, seeded-random spectra, and unison width for animated modern tones. Performance and modulation: Poly, mono, and legato voice modes with adjustable glide (portamento) for tight monophonic basses and expressive, gliding leads. Two XY pads with four routable axes. Record XY pad motion per engine and save it with the patch. Route LFOs, envelopes, velocity, aftertouch, pitch bend, mod wheel, CC74, and XY pad axes to musical targets. Move oscillator pitch and mix, FM index and ratios, Karplus brightness and decay, wavetable position and detune, filter, pan, gain, LFO rates, and master-FX controls. 6503036374.description: GeekMath Classic 终身﻿版 像思维一样计算，探索关联计算的奇妙魅力 每一个计算元素过程都可以快速修改和定义，提升计算效率 真正适合全平台的计算器解决方案 Geekmath Classic iCloud 多设备实时同步 尝试过 Geekmath Classic ，它将会成为你不可或缺的计算工具 核心特性 跨行联动运算 元素链接 对象标注 iCloud 同步 全平台支持 可自定义样式 终 身使用 免﻿登陆且无 任何使用﻿时间﻿限制 多语言特性 Multi-Language GeekMath 全面支持多种语言，包括简体中文、English、日本语、法语等 可切换工作区 WorkSpace (高级订阅) 四个可随时切换的工作区，并支持跨设备上传下载，苹果设备支持 iCloud 同步 每个工作区可以独立修改标题和算法，并可预览内容 算法标题 MethodTitle 在 Geekmath Classic 中，我们引入了算法标题功能，可以快速定义算法名称 实时预览 RealtimeResult 在新的 Geekmath Classic 中，我们提供了更强的计算联动引擎，无需输入等号=，只要有计算内容就能直接显示结果，快速响应计算需求 计算单元 MathUnit Geekmath Classic 中更新了强大的 MathUnit 计算单元，支持对数、平方根、指数、自由指数、自由底数、分数、百分数、三角函数、角度等快捷编辑和运算，大幅提升联动运算的可靠性 科学记数法 Scientific Notation 支持可自定义小数保留位数的科学记数法和千分位记数法，满足不同用户需求 快速换行 QuickReturn 当输入焦点处于计算结果时，等号将自动转换为换行符，便于快速换行 计算结果个性化 UserRes (Beta) 用户可手动将计算结果切换为目标显示类型 快捷计算 UserRes (Beta) 用户可手动将计算结果切换为目标显示类型 折叠屏/平板自由窗口 PadSupport 支持原生 iPadOS 分屏，各品牌折叠屏大屏模式，iPad 台前调度窗口任意大小，侧边小窗等功能 五档内容大小 5-Level Content-Size Geekmath Classic 用户可自由调节内容大小，适配不同设备，获取最佳用户体验 快捷样式 QuickStyle 快速调节保留位数、内容大小及深色模式 可定义字体 UserFont (高级订阅) 可根据喜好改变计算器的内容字体 键盘布局 KeyLayout 可根据使用习惯改变计算器布局 震动/按键音反馈 React Native 提供三种震动反馈和按键音，提升触摸屏设备的使用体验 自适应深色模式 NightMode 移动设备上提供更好的深色模式体验，可跟随系统深色模式切换，并可跟随账户设置保存用户喜好 Apple 设备独占的 iCloud 实时同步功能 全新上架 Apple Store，支持 iPhone，同时为所有 iPadOS/MacOS 设备带来全功能支持 iCloud 设备实时同步 (高级订阅) 通过 iCloud 实时同步，所有运行 Geekmath Classic 的苹果设备，包括 iPhone、iPad、Mac、VisionPro 等，都能开启全时同步。计算会实时同步到所有登录相同 GeekMath 账号和 iCloud 账号的设备上，自动锁定焦点，方便在任意设备上继续计算。计算空间的选择和编辑也会实时同步到所有设备。通过 Geekmath Classic 的算法存档 CloudMethod 和可切换工作区 WorkSpace，手动同步﻿其他端的 Geekmath Classic 上 iPadOS 原生台前调度 支持原生 iPadOS 分屏、台前调度窗口任意大小、侧边小窗等功能

6791314222.name: 啊啊啊-大声喊出来的声控解压神器
6791314222.trackName: 啊啊啊-大声喊出来的声控解压神器
6791314222.description: 气到不行的时候，打开它，对着手机喊一嗓子。 满屏的字——加班、考试、前任的名字——像纸贴纸一样砸下来，把小人埋住。你喊得越大声，炸得越猛：字被炸飞、纸屑四溅、手机跟着震。喊完那一刻，整个人都松了。 【怎么玩】 点「开始发泄」，想炸的字从天而降 对着手机大喊，音量越大，炸掉的字越多 拍个手、打个响指、吹声口哨，也能引爆 不方便出声？点「手动爽一下」，按住蓄力松手开炸 炸光一波，再来一波，越炸越多，直到爽够为止 【想炸啥写啥】 内置通用、上班族、学生党、情感四组词库；也可以自己输入——老板的名字、那句咽不下去的话，写上去，亲手炸掉。摇一摇手机，随机换一个。 【五只纸艺搭子】 土拨鼠、鳄鱼、打工人、小火山、纸箱人，双击小人就能换。换到纸箱人时，试试长按它——有惊喜。 【每一个字都是贴纸】 纸艺贴纸质感：彩色文字、三档字号、三种字体、散乱度随你调，炸起来像撕碎一整页手账。 【喊完，好好收个尾】 没有分数、没有排名、不算成绩。发泄完只有一句话陪你收尾——深呼吸，碎的是它，不是你。想分享的话，一张纸艺卡片把「今天炸掉的坏心情」发给朋友。 【安心喊】 麦克风只用来检测音量和识别拍手口哨，不录音、不上传 完全离线，不联网、不注册

6784557229.name: MIDI CC Controller – LogicFlow
6784557229.description: Three vertical touch faders. Any MIDI CC. Any Logic Pro parameter. LogicFlow Touch gives you three precision touch bars on your iPhone, each sending MIDI CC to Logic Pro in real time via the free LogicFlow DAW Bridge on your Mac. Play expression, velocity, and dynamics with your fingers while your hands stay on your instrument. TOUCH FADERS Three full-height vertical touch bars — drag up for more, down for less. Smooth, precise, 0 to 127 range. Each bar sends MIDI CC independently. ASSIGN ANY MIDI CC Long press any bar to reassign it instantly. 14 built-in presets: Expression (CC11), Modulation (CC1), Volume (CC7), Dynamics, Pan, Sustain, Reverb, Chorus, and more. Or enter any CC number 0 to 127 manually. MIDI LEARN Press Command-L in Logic Pro, click any parameter, move a touch bar. Logic learns it in one second. Assign to any plugin knob, fader, or instrument parameter without any setup. SWAP AND RELABEL Swap bar positions with one tap. Rename each bar to match your workflow. MIDI channel selector for channels 1 to 16. PART OF THE LOGICFLOW ECOSYSTEM Works alongside LogicFlow Pro (Apple Watch DAW controller) and LogicFlow DAW Bridge (free Mac companion app). All three apps connect to the same bridge — your Watch controls transport while your iPhone controls expression. REQUIREMENTS iPhone running iOS 16 or later. LogicFlow DAW Bridge (free, Mac App Store). Logic Pro on Mac. Bluetooth enabled. LogicFlo — Built for producers who move.

6504736649.name: Word of the Day by LookUp
6504736649.trackName: Word of the Day by LookUp
6504736649.description: Word of the Day by LookUp enables you to build your vocabulary daily through beautiful illustrations that make remembering words easy and fun. Learn Anywhere with Widgets and Shortcuts: Word of the Day by LookUp meets you where you are. You can add Word of the Day widgets to your Lock Screen, Home Screen, or Standby Mode. You can also add automations using Shortcuts to get a new word every day. Each word is accompanied by an example sentence and pronunciation, and you can learn more about it in the LookUp app, which has even more details and tools to enable better learning. Ideal for learners practicing for their SAT, GRE, TOEFL, or IELTS tests, people building their vocabulary for everyday use, or simply anyone who love to learn new words! Buy Once, Use Anywhere: Word of the Day by LookUp is available on all major platforms, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro. You just need to buy the app once and you can use it anywhere. No Ads, No Subscriptions, No Hidden Costs.

6792640530.name: Reelatch
6792640530.description: 一整场球赛，真正想留下的往往只有几个精彩回合。 传统剪辑需要反复暂停、拖动时间轴、寻找起点和终点。Reelatch 把这套流程变成一个更自然的动作：看到精彩时按住，回合结束就松手。 你只管继续看比赛，Reelatch 会把每次按住的内容自动整理成片段，并拼接成一支完整集锦。 【剪辑就像看比赛一样自然】 1. 从相册选择一段视频 2. 点击播放 3. 精彩时按住按钮 4. 回合结束时松手 5. 所有片段自动排好，直接预览和导出 松手后可以立刻跳过发球准备、捡球、暂停和场间等待，不必为了找下一个回合反复拖动时间轴。 【特别适合球类运动】 Reelatch 很适合网球、羽毛球、排球、乒乓球等回合边界清晰的运动，也适用于篮球、足球训练、宠物、旅行和其他长视频中的精彩片段整理。 【更快看完，更准确留下】 支持 0.5×、1×、1.5× 和 2× 播放速度 可设置按住前与松开后自动多保留的时间 多个精彩回合自动排成片段 拖动起点和终点，对单个片段进行微调 每个片段都可以单独调整倍速 自动拼接后保存到相册或通过系统分享 【先体验，再决定】 免费下载 前 2 次成功导出可体验完整流程 之后可一次购买，永久解锁无限次导出 不订阅，不会自动续费 已购买旧付费版本的用户会自动保留永久权限 【视频留在你的设备上】 视频选择、剪辑和导出都在设备本地完成。Reelatch 不上传原始视频或导出结果，不包含广告，也不使用追踪或分析 SDK。 别再把一整场比赛重新剪一遍。打开视频，按住精彩，松手继续看下一球。

6786123132.name: 爱商店 —商店地区浏览工具
6786123132.trackName: 爱商店 —商店地区浏览工具
6786123132.description: 爱商店是一款简洁高效的工具，帮你轻松探索全球 App Store 地区。一键打开各地区的 App Store 页面，发现只在其他国家或地区上架的应用，并查询某个应用在各地的上架情况与价格——全部都能通过小组件、快捷指令等快速完成。 说明：打开地区 App Store 页面不会更改你的 Apple 账户国家或地区，也不影响你的支付设置。 为什么选择爱商店 通过公开的 App Store 链接，快速访问 175 个国家与地区店面 为效率而生：桌面小组件、锁屏、控制中心、Siri、快捷指令与聚焦搜索 完整工作流，而非只是链接列表：收藏、置顶、常用地区、地区历史与整理工具 浏览地区 175 个地区，按大洲、常用与最近打开智能分组 三种布局任选：列表、网格、卡片 支持按国家或地区名称（中文或英文）、地区代码、Alpha-3 代码搜索 地图选区：直接在世界地图上点选地区 自动识别当前所在店面，随时知道你在哪里浏览 访问 App Store 后回到 App 时，会显示贴心返回提示 收藏与整理 收藏常用地区，把最常用的置顶到最前面 可用列表、网格或全屏滑动卡片呈现 按大洲分组、自定义排序，并可拖拽调整顺序 批量选择，一次打开、置顶或管理多个地区 查询上架与价格 粘贴 App Store 链接或 ID，即可查看某个应用在各地的上架状态与当地价格 可查询常用地区、我的收藏或全部 175 个地区，结果逐地区实时呈现 对已上架的地区，可打开对应 App Store 页面 支持 Siri 语音查询，或在 Safari 与 App Store 中通过分享菜单直达 小组件与控件 桌面小组件：常用地区、自定义地区、最近地区 锁屏小组件：圆形、矩形与行内样式 控制中心控件：一键打开上次访问的地区（iOS 18） 交互式小组件按钮：在桌面直接打开地区（iOS 17） Siri、快捷指令与聚焦搜索 打开上次地区、打开某个收藏、查询上架情况，都可用语音完成 在快捷指令 App 中通过深层链接搭建自动化 在聚焦搜索里输入国家名，即可在爱商店中快速打开 更多 iCloud 同步收藏、历史与偏好，多设备保持一致 支持 iPad 分栏、动态字体与旁白无障碍 浅色与深色主题、三种界面语言、灵活的地区名显示 爱商店为独立工具，与 Apple Inc. 无关联。App Store 是 Apple Inc. 的商标。

6759366712.name: Bedtime Fan Sounds : Fanly
6759366712.description: Struggling to sleep or focus? Create your perfect calming environment with soothing nature sounds and realistic fan noise—all in one beautifully designed app. Whether you need deep sleep, relaxation, meditation, or better focus, this app helps you unwind anytime, anywhere. Key Features Nature Sounds Collection Enjoy a wide range of high-quality relaxing sounds like rain, night ambiance, and peaceful landscapes. Realistic Fan Sounds Choose from different fan types like Box Fan, Desk Fan, and Ceiling Fan for consistent white noise. 6762387897.name: 反转片场
6762387897.description: 反转片场会把普通日常瞬间变成电影感假海报，让你几秒内保存和分享。 写下一件小小翻车，选择一种类型片能量，应用就会把它包装成片名、标语、剧情简介、海报概念和社交分享文案。它不是空白 AI 聊天框，而是一台为群聊节奏设计的造梗机器。 你可以用反转片场： 每天用「每日挑战」获得一个新套路。 用「挑选一个真实瞬间」从 Apple 的私密建议中选一项开始创作。 用「自由发挥」指定想要的类型片语气。 在支持的设备上使用 Apple Intelligence 打磨海报文案。 在 Apple Intelligence 不可用时继续使用本地备用文案生成。 添加参考照片，给海报画面更明确的方向。 把喜欢的海报保存在设备本地图库里。 用社交导出包生成精确的 4:5 动态、9:16 故事和 1:1 方形图片。 一键分享海报，或复制已经写好的分享文案。 反转片场默认本地优先。你的日常瞬间和导入照片都会留在设备上，除非你主动选择分享。

自动字幕：本地识别人声生成带时间轴字幕，还可识别音乐、掌声等声音事件；支持识别语言选择、双语翻译、样式预设、字重与阴影、底框与描边透明度、横排竖排与精细对齐；结果可逐条编辑或删除；可导出 SRT 或 ASS，也可直接烧录进视频。长视频优先走设备端现代识别路径，更稳、更完整；离线语言模型可在系统设置中下载，识别仍然不离开你的设备 按文字剪辑：把口播转成带时间的文稿，删掉一句话，对应画面片段自动剪掉，适合教程、访谈和会议纪要去废话 文字识别 OCR：一键提取当前画面文字，结果可编辑，也可复制或分享；关掉再打开，刚才的结果还在，不用反复识别 人脸自动打码与手动框选打码，车牌、招牌、角标也能罩住，分享前保护他人隐私 一键清除元数据：去除 EXIF、GPS、创建时间与设备指纹，适合外发、投稿与长期存档 场景与章节自动检测，列表点按即可跳到切点，长录屏回看不再靠盲拖；自动去静音跳剪，口播更紧凑；音频降噪与人声增强，并支持即时试听，调到满意再导出 逐帧标注：箭头、圈、框、笔迹与文字，适合讲解、动作分析和复盘，可导出为图片 【专业工作台，31 个工具】 截图、拆帧、视频信息、场景章节、文字识别、调色示波器、逐帧标注、时长裁剪、画面裁剪、旋转、按文字剪辑、卡点混剪、去静音、变速、倒放、变速曲线、静音、音频分离、字幕、降噪增强、水印、清元数据、压缩、人脸打码、调色、实况照片、GIF、社媒画幅、前后对比、笔记、帧对比，都在同一个暗色工作台里完成。工具按基础、剪辑、速度、音频、画面、转换、笔记分组，选中后下方给出说明和主操作，不会一上来就弹一层层菜单。需要微调时再打开参数面板，主按钮直接导出，进度在画面中央，可以取消。处理过程全程可中断，半成品会清理干净。导出完成可直接分享，也可进入导出队列查看进度、取消任务或分享成品。 前后对比拼屏导出，适合教程前后效果；视频与实况照片互转，关键帧时间线三手柄可视化选择，或导出 GIF，支持批量 【多轨剪辑工程】 底部常驻「剪辑工程」标签：工程列表支持搜索、多选、排序、网格或列表、封面、重命名与复制，管理方式对齐视频库 多片段时间线：分割、换序、交叉叠化；顶部刻度尺、拖动定位、双指缩放；iPhone 竖屏预览最大化，iPad 与横屏右侧检视器常驻 定时文字与贴图叠加：6 套文字样式预设，描边或底框、字重、阴影、透明度与自定义取色，预览与导出一致，标题、字幕条和角标都能做 视频画中画可自由拖动定位，四角快捷贴边，预览跟手不闪断；背景音乐与旁白，说话时自动压低配乐，音量拖动即时生效 设备端画面稳定、智能构图跟随人脸横转竖、平滑慢动作，效果可移除回到原片，不破坏原始素材 双机位偏移对齐，可硬切切换或角落画中画；发布向导设置平台画幅、封面帧、烧录或导出字幕、以及仅作用于本次的导出倍速，时间线速度不会被改掉 自包含工程目录，素材拷进工程，删库也不断链；自动保存，撤销与重做；关闭时确认保留或放弃；内置剪辑工程教程，上手更快 【专业级播放器】 暗色优先预览，按真实宽高比显示，双击进入沉浸全屏 剪辑师风格 JKL 快退快进、自定义任意倍速 0.05 到 8 倍，含预设与最近用过，对数滑杆更易微调极慢与极快 拖动进度条显示浮动缩略图、预览区水平滑动快速定位、快退快进十秒、逐帧步进与触觉反馈；松手后按原意图继续播放 画中画与 AirPlay 投屏；锁屏与灵动岛可通过实时活动显示当前倍速；iPad 与 Mac 键盘全控，空格播放，方向键逐帧，J K L 变档 即使打开静音开关，工作台、剪辑工程与多机位预览仍可正常出声，不再对着画面猜有没有声 6454232823.description: Stackrover is a unique interactive manual, training app, and knowledge base for all JavaScript developers. Build your skills and gain insight while waiting for a lunch or during any dull moment. Ditch all your fears and achieve real mastery step by step. Get prepared for any task you are up to. Let Javascript finally make sense! No sign-up, no ads, no recurring fees. Works fully offline. 6755364840.name: Hours: Time & Invoice
6755364840.description: Hours is the quickest way to turn time worked into a number you can send. No spreadsheet, no clunky invoicing suite — just your clients, your hours, and the total owing. Add your clients and hours, set your rate, fold in GST or another tax, and share a clean summary. The amount updates as you type, so you always know where you stand. WHY HOURS Hours by client — log time against as many clients as the week needs Rate & tax — set an hourly rate and add GST or another adjustment Instant total — see the amount owing update as you type Shareable summary — export a tidy image to send straight on MADE FOR SMALL OPERATORS Freelancers, contractors, side-hustlers — anyone who bills by the hour and doesn't want accounting software to do it. Fast to log, faster to send. STAYS ON YOUR PHONE Your clients and hours live on your device. No account, no cloud, no sign-up.

6760505792.name: Body Cam Pro
6760505792.description: Body Cam Pro turns your iPhone into a simple, powerful wearable body cam. Choose the front camera or back cameras, start recording fast with one tap and capture video hands-free from your pocket, on a lanyard or a body strap. Whether you’re documenting your job to stay safe, a day out, recording point-of-view footage or recording secret video - Body Cam Pro is built to make recording quick, discreet and reliable. Body Cam Pro also includes stealth screen controls that can dim or black out the display while recording, so your phone can keep capturing without a bright screen drawing attention. When you need to check the app again, built-in gestures and safety controls help you reveal the screen or stop recording without accidental taps getting in the way. Features: Record with the front camera or back cameras Now with double camera recording - Record the selfie camera and one selected back camera at the same time. Saves as two separate video files. Choose video resolution: 720p, 1080p or 4K Choose frame rate options where supported by your device Select your preferred back lens for different recording styles Stealth recording mode with screen dimming and blackout options Touch safety controls to help prevent accidental stops Automatic saving to your Camera Roll when recording ends or phone is locked Clean, fast interface designed for quick recording Can be added to the action button or the lock screen. Great for: POV and wearable video Stay safe at work Travel and day-out recording Behind-the-scenes creator footage Personal documentation Everyday hands-free capture Secret body cam footage Body Cam Pro is made for fast access, simple controls and flexible recording when you want your iPhone to work more like a body cam and less like a traditional camera app. Always use Body Cam Pro responsibly and only where recording is legal.

6755829730.name: PulseTempo: Heart Metronome
6755829730.description: PulseTempo is a metronome designed to beat with you. By leveraging your Apple Watch, PulseTempo reads your real-time heart rate to create a living, organic beat. Whether you're a musician looking for a "flow state" during your practice or simply want to hear the rhythm of your heart during your meditation sessions, PulseTempo is the simple tool you need. BIOMETRIC RHYTHM (Apple Watch Required) Turn your pulse into a beat you hear. PulseTempo detects your heart rate via your Apple Watch and instantly translates it into a rock-solid BPM directly on your Apple Watch or on your iPhone. Your metronome adapts as your heart rate changes. Even without heart rate sync, PulseTempo is a world-class metronome built for demanding musicians, packed with features. Standalone on Apple Watch: You can use the metronome directly on Apple Watch and hear the beat coming from your watch's speakers. Sample-Accurate Timing: The ultra-stable audio engine ensures zero-latency performance. High-Quality Sound Library: Choose from a set of curated high-quality samples to find the tone that cuts through your mix. Automatic Downbeat Accents: Set your "Beats per Measure" and PulseTempo applies a distinct accent to the "1" of every measure. Minimalist Interface: Stay focused on your music or meditation sessions without complex menus. MEDICAL DISCLAIMER: PulseTempo is intended for musical and fitness purposes only. It is not a medical device and should not be used for the diagnosis, treatment, or monitoring of any medical condition. Please consult a healthcare professional for any heart-health concerns.

6787959974.name: KiraSpark 闪闪相机
6787959974.description: 用 KiraSpark 闪闪相机，把细小光点变成清晰、上镜的星芒。它是一款专注闪光效果的照片编辑工具，适合首饰、水晶、玻璃、亮片、彩妆与香水、节日装饰、夜景、城市灯光、自拍、商品照片，以及每个值得多一点光彩的瞬间。 实时拍摄或导入照片 使用前置或后置相机构图时即可预览闪光效果，也可以从“照片”中选择现有图片。可选 1:1、4:3 或 16:9 画幅，让构图直接适合动态、帖子、消息与珍藏。 打造你的风格 拖动强度控制，从轻柔微光调到醒目星芒。 选择原色、冰霜、金色、黑白、梦幻或霓虹色彩风格。 拍摄或导出前，同时预览闪光效果与色彩处理。 无需面对复杂的编辑时间线，也能细调成片。 轻点几下即可保存和分享 预览中看到的，就是 KiraSpark 保存的效果。你可以将成片以高质量 JPEG 导出到“照片”，也可以打开 iOS 分享面板，发送到任意应用。流程始终刻意保持简单：打开、添加闪光、调整、保存。 隐私融入设计 闪光渲染在你的设备上完成。KiraSpark 无需账号，也没有云端工作区、广告、应用内购买或追踪。除非你主动保存或分享结果，整个创作流程都会留在自己的 iPhone 或 iPad 上。 无论是润饰戒指特写、点亮派对灯光、为美妆照片增添华彩，还是让安静夜景焕发生机，KiraSpark 都能突出光点，不让照片编辑变成一项繁琐工程。

6772425829.name: 哮喘日记-峰流速症状用药ACT控制测试记录与离线导出
6772425829.trackName: 哮喘日记-峰流速症状用药ACT控制测试记录与离线导出
6772425829.description: 哮喘日记是一款离线哮喘健康管理手账，无需注册账号，数据仅存本机。每日记录症状、用药与峰流速，红/黄/绿分区一目了然，帮助您掌握控制情况。 支持 ACT 哮喘控制测试、诱因分析、个人行动计划与急救指南；可记录睡眠、情绪与健康指标，图表统计长期趋势。内置哮喘科普内容，仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗建议。 【核心功能】 每日哮喘日志：症状、用药、峰流速记录 峰流速分区：红/黄/绿警示与趋势图表 用药管理：控制药与缓解药打卡 ACT 控制测试：定期评估控制水平 诱因分析：发现常见触发因素 行动计划：个性化应对步骤 睡眠、情绪与健康指标记录 数据统计与多周期图表 急救指南与哮喘知识库 纯离线本地存储，支持导入导出 适合需要私密、简单、不绑账号的哮喘日常管理工具。本应用非医疗器械，信息仅供参考。

6760335269.description: Shadow Proは、シャドーイングを通して英語のリスニングとスピーキングを同時に鍛える英語学習アプリです。音声を聞きながらすぐに発話するトレーニングにより、自然な英語表現や発音を身につけることができます。 アプリには4つの難易度と7つのビジネス＆日常英会話テーマを用意し、合計280レッスンを収録しています。 すべてのレッスンには英文スクリプトと日本語訳が付いているため、内容を理解しながらシャドーイング練習を行うことができます。さらに学習カレンダーで日々の学習記録を確認でき、継続的な英語学習をサポートします。 ■ 機能 ・音声の再生・一時停止・速度変更（0.5倍速〜1倍速） ・自分の声を録音して再生し、発音を確認 ・学習カレンダーで「続けた日」を記録 ・1テーマ10レッスン完了で金メダル、1難易度70レッスン完了で金トロフィーを獲得 シャドーイングでリスニングとスピーキングを同時にトレーニング 英文スクリプト＆日本語訳つき

6790058615.name: 初中几何辅助线题卡2026
6790058615.description: 初中几何辅助线题卡是一款为初中数学几何证明学习设计的离线题型整理工具。应用不提供拍照搜题和联网答案，而是帮助学生把常见辅助线方法、证明步骤、易错原因和复习批次沉淀成本地题卡。 核心功能： 1. 辅助线题型库：整理倍长中线、截长补短、角平分线、垂线、平行线、圆中辅助线等常见题型。 2. 图形标注卡：记录题目条件、目标结论、已添加辅助线、关键等量关系和证明突破口。 3. 步骤拆解：按“观察图形、选择辅助线、寻找全等或相似、整理证明”记录解题链路。 4. 错因复盘：标记不会作线、条件漏用、证明跳步、图形误判等错因，方便考前回看。 5. 复习批次：按掌握度、题型、考试范围筛选题卡，安排阶段复习。 6. 本地备份：所有题卡和复习记录均保存在设备本地，可手动导出备份。 适合正在学习初中平面几何、准备期中期末、中考一轮复习，或希望系统整理几何证明思路的学生使用。

6778812752.name: Librarto: Tidy Up Your Library
6778812752.description: Librarto is a simple puzzle game, with a clear goal: tidy up your arcane library! You're a librarian, and by the looks of it, somebody (or something) has made a mess throwing all of the books from the shelves to the floor. While mildly infuriating, it's a great occasion to refresh your knowledge regarding the books that have been gathering dust for the past centuries. Dive into the stories, romances, and arcane guides - once a collection is completed, it'll give you a special ability to either cozy up the library, or bring more pace to the sorting: your choice! Play as you wish, either be as fast as possible, or enjoy creating patterns on the shelves: after all, the journey might be as fun as the destination.

6778002145.trackName: 鉴机 - 硬件检测与诊断

6760857073.name: AXIØM 语音激活录音机
6760857073.description: 干净且免费的语音激活录音应用程序，可以将任何旧的iPhone变成专用语音录音机。 – 零广告和完全匿名的使用分析，您的录音不会离开您的设备，直到您决定将其分享到其他应用程序或转移到文件中 – 无人工智能或转录功能，纯音频录制 – 使用电池可以连续录音一整天（24小时），电池还剩余（iPhone SE上使用约50%） –录音是语音激活的，静音部分被省略（很少找到应用程序功能！） –即使屏幕关闭，录音也能正常工作！ – 录音不会中断（旨在重新利用旧 iPhone，因此建议使用飞行模式） –录音受到崩溃保护！（录音期间有5分钟的片段，导出时将其合并为完整的64 kbps单声道M4A文件） – 与iOS 15.6+兼容（从垃圾抽屉后面掏出那些旧机型！） – 语言支持包括法语、西班牙语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语和中文（简体和繁体） 本应用程序的使用受《欧盟标准服务协议》的约束，详情请参阅 http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

6792675339.name: ACO 投考全攻略 ACOReady
6792675339.description: ACOReady ACO 投考全攻略，是為準備投考香港政府助理文書主任 (ACO) 及 文書助理 (CA) 的考生而設的備考 App。無論你正在準備全年招聘、技能測試、中文及英文打字、Microsoft Word / Excel 應用測試、基本法及香港國安法測試，還是希望提前練習遴選面試，ACOReady 都可以幫你把備考拆成更清晰、更可執行的每日訓練。 投考 ACO / CA 不是只填申請表就完成。考生需要同時準備學歷及語文要求、中文及英文輸入速度、常用辦公室軟件、部門職責理解、文書工作態度、客戶服務意識、保密意識、團隊合作、時間管理及面試表達。ACOReady 的設計重點不是單純提供資料，而是幫你建立一套可追蹤、可修正、可持續的備考流程。 主要功能： 中文及英文打字練習 ACO / CA 招聘要求考生具備中文及英文文字處理能力。ACOReady 可用作日常打字速度訓練，幫助你建立中英文輸入節奏，逐步改善準確度、穩定度和限時表現。 Office 技能測試準備 App 可整理 Word、Excel 及常見辦公室軟件應用重點，協助你熟習文書處理、表格整理、基本格式設定、資料輸入、排序、簡單公式及日常行政工作會遇到的操作邏輯。 基本法及香港國安法測試重溫 投考公務員職位一般需要符合基本法及香港國安法測試要求。ACOReady 可協助你整理重溫方向、建立考前提醒，避免只集中準備面試而忽略入職要求。 面試模擬題庫 提供不同類型的面試練習題，涵蓋投考動機、自我介紹、辦公室工作態度、文書準確性、保密責任、客戶服務、壓力處理、部門支援角色、團隊合作及情境判斷。你可以按題型分類練習，也可以用搜尋功能快速找到相關題目。 90 秒錄音自測 面試不能只在心裏想答案，而是要真正說出口。ACOReady 內置錄音練習，你可以在限時內回答問題，再重聽自己的語速、停頓、內容結構和表達。這有助你發現自己是否講得太散、太短、太口號式，或未能展現穩定、細心、有責任感的文書人員特質。 正反答案對照 每條面試題提供答題策略、建議回答方向及常見錯誤示範，幫助你理解甚麼是清晰、務實、有服務意識和保密意識的回答，同時避開過分空泛、背稿式或與文書工作不符的答案。 自我評分與反思筆記 完成練習後，你可以根據檢核準則為自己的回答評分，並記下需要改善的地方。App 會保存練習紀錄，讓你知道自己練過哪些題目、哪些題型仍未覆蓋、哪些回答需要再次修正。 技巧庫與考前提醒 技巧庫整理申請流程、技能測試準備、打字練習方法、Office 重點、面試禮儀、文書工作常見情境、基本法及國安法測試準備等內容。你亦可以設定考前提醒，保持每日練習節奏，減少臨測試前才倉促準備的情況。 適合以下考生： 正在準備投考 ACO / CA 的人 想練習中文及英文打字速度的人 需要準備 Word、Excel 及辦公室軟件技能測試的人 想重溫基本法及香港國安法測試方向的人 想練習文書職系面試、自我介紹及情境題回答的人 工作或讀書繁忙，只能用碎片時間備考的人 希望用手機集中整理技能測試、面試、技巧和提醒的人 重要聲明： 入職條件、招聘程序、技能測試內容、打字要求、薪酬、福利及工作安排可能會更新，請以公務員事務局及香港政府官方公布的最新資料為準。 由申請、技能測試到遴選面試，ACOReady 幫你把投考 ACO / CA 的準備變成更有方向的每日訓練。

6760751399.name: 房产投资计算器
6760751399.description: 买房赚了还是亏了？一算便知。 大多数人买卖房产时，只关注购入价和卖出价的差额。但真实的投资回报，远不止表面数字。贷款利息、契税、增值税、个税、中介费、物业费、装修成本、资金机会成本……这些隐性支出往往占据总成本的相当比例，却常常被忽略。一笔看似赚了50万的交易，算清全部成本后可能只赚了10万，甚至亏损。 「房产收益」是一款专业级房产投资分析工具。它帮你全面核算所有隐性成本，精准计算房产投资的真实回报率——让你在买入前看清风险，卖出时把握时机，交易后复盘得失。 【两大核心模式】 ◆ 计划卖出：还没卖？先算算账 输入房产信息，自动生成多种涨幅情景（0%~100%及自定义），直观对比不同卖价下的净利润和收益率。还能看到回本价格、以及达到5%/10%/15%收益所需的卖价。 ◆ 已经卖出：卖完了？复盘收益 输入实际卖价，一键计算净利润、总收益率、年化收益率（CAGR）、杠杆收益率，全面评估这笔交易的真实表现。 【精准计算，覆盖全部成本】 贷款利息：支持等额本息和等额本金，仅计算持有期内实付利息 税费：契税、增值税（满2年自动免征）、个人所得税 中介费：支持按比例或固定金额，买卖双方分别设置 持有成本：物业费、装修费 机会成本：首付资金的替代投资收益 租金收入：出租收入抵扣持有成本，自住可填等价租金 【实用功能】 多涨幅场景一键对比，辅助决策 回本价和收益里程碑，目标一目了然 历史记录保存，方便多套房产横向比较 支持分享计算结果 【隐私保护】 所有计算均在本地完成，无需注册账号，不采集任何个人数据。你的财务信息只属于你自己。 一套房动辄几十上百万，花几块钱算清真实收益，是最划算的投资决策。无论你正在评估是否入手、考虑何时卖出、还是想复盘一笔已完成的交易——打开「房产收益」，让数字告诉你答案。

6778917523.description: 这是一款完全离线运行、不上传任何隐私的智能短信拦截工具，基于苹果本地机器学习大模型（Core ML）打造，所有AI推理与拦截判断仅在你的iPhone本地完成，全程无需联网、不上传短信内容、不收集任何个人数据。无订阅、无内购、无后续收费。一次性买断，永久享受全部功能，支持后续模型迭代与功能更新。 使用说明: 设置 -> 信息 -> 启用筛选未知发件人 -> 短信过滤器中选择短信分拣盒 【核心功能】 三级智能过滤：白名单 → 黑名单 → AI模型 关键词自定义：预设 + 手动添加 规则测试：即时验证过滤效果 【产品特色】 纯离线运行：无后台联网，不上传数据 隐私零泄露：无SDK，无广告，数据本地存储 极简体验：黑白灰金科技风，简洁高效

6757775930.name: 星星陪伴
6757775930.description: 一款专为中小学生设计的心理健康应用，用简单易懂的方式，帮助你记录心情、管理任务、专注学习，让每一天的进步都能被看见。 核心功能 心情打卡 每天记录你的心情和状态，看看最近的变化。用简单的表情和滑动条，轻松记录今天的心情和累的程度。所有记录都是私密的，只有你自己能看到。 学习帮手 记录今天要做的事，最多3个，不会让你感到压力。还有专注计时器，帮你专心学习25分钟，然后好好休息。完成任务的你，会获得小星星奖励。 工具箱 提供多种放松和调节心情的方法： 深呼吸游戏：7种不同的呼吸方法，跟着做就能放松 放松练习：静下来，感受现在的自己 换个想法：帮你重新思考问题，换个角度看事情 写写心情：把心里的话写下来，会舒服一些 想法小助手：用AI帮你换个更合理的想法 小任务：完成小任务，心情会好一点 看看我在想什么：基于你的记录，给你一些建议 我的小花园 收集小星星，看看自己有多棒。记录心情打卡、完成任务、专注学习的次数，每完成一次都有小星星奖励。看看自己收集了多少小星星，每个进步都值得庆祝。 需要帮助 如果你感觉很难过，或者想要伤害自己或别人，这里会告诉你应该找谁帮忙，以及可以先做什么。 应用特点 简单易懂：所有功能都用中小学生能理解的语言，不需要专业知识 私密安全：所有数据都保存在你的手机上，只有你能看到 游戏化设计：完成任务获得小星星，让进步变得有趣 AI智能分析：基于你的使用记录，给你个性化的建议和反馈 引导反思：通过提问和分析，帮助你提升认知能力，而不是简单的安慰 适合谁用 想要记录心情、了解自己的中小学生 需要管理学习任务、提高专注力的学生 想要学习放松方法、调节情绪的学生 希望看到自己进步、获得鼓励的学生 设计理念 我们相信，每个学生都有自己的节奏和方式。这个应用不会批评你，不会要求你完美，只是帮助你： 记录真实的自己 完成小任务，获得成就感 学习放松和调节的方法 看到自己的进步 每一步都很小，但每一步都值得庆祝。 隐私保护 所有数据都保存在你的设备上 不会收集你的个人信息 不会分享给任何人 你可以随时删除所有数据 使用建议 每天花几分钟记录心情 把大任务拆成小任务 累了就试试深呼吸游戏 看看自己收集的小星星，给自己点个赞 记住，进步不需要完美，只需要开始。

6755061315.name: Learn PyTorch Tutorials
6755061315.description: Ready to master PyTorch? "Learn PyTorch" is your comprehensive, pocket-sized guide to mastering one of the world's most popular deep learning frameworks. Whether you are a student, a developer, or just curious about AI, our app provides a structured path from beginner to proficient. Structured Learning Path Start your journey with 135 carefully crafted lessons, organized into easy-to-follow modules. You'll begin with "Getting Started with PyTorch" and move through "PyTorch Basics and Autograd System," "Neural Network Fundamentals," "The torch.nn Module," and much more. Each lesson is designed to build your knowledge step-by-step. Test Your Knowledge Don't just read—apply! Reinforce your learning with interactive quizzes at the end of lessons. Get immediate feedback with a "Detailed Review of All Questions," showing you exactly what you got right and wrong, with clear explanations for the correct answers. Track Your Success Stay motivated by watching your progress grow. The app features a beautiful dashboard showing your "Overall Progress" toward completing all 135 lessons. "Your Stats" track your best streak, your last active day, and your total lessons completed. You can also see module-level progress to know exactly where to pick up. Find What You Need, Fast Use the powerful "Search Lessons" feature to find any lesson by title or category. You can also explore "Popular Topics" using tags like #basics, #variables, and #functions to quickly jump to relevant content. A Learning Experience Built for You Customize the app to fit your personal style. Theme: Choose between a sleek "Light Mode" or a focused "Dark Mode." Get Help When You Need It Stuck on a real-world problem? The integrated "Help Center" allows you to search Stack Overflow directly for PyTorch-related questions and answers, all without leaving the app. Download "Learn PyTorch" today and start building the future of artificial intelligence.

6780809845.name: TiDB Associate Prep
6780809845.description: Get ready for the PingCAP Certified TiDB Associate (PCTA) certification with 500 original practice questions you can study anytime, anywhere, completely offline. Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by PingCAP. "TiDB", "TiKV", and "PingCAP" are trademarks of their respective owners, used here only to describe the exam this app helps you prepare for. All 500 questions are original content. WHAT'S INSIDE 500 original questions organized into study areas that follow the exam topics: Architecture and Storage (TiDB, TiKV, Regions, Raft) SQL and Transactions (MySQL compatibility, MVCC, isolation) Deployment and HTAP (TiUP, TiFlash, real-time analytics) Operations and Reliability (monitoring, backup, migration) Performance and Ecosystem (tuning, TiCDC, TiDB Cloud) MULTIPLE-CHOICE FORMAT Every question uses a clean four-option format. Submit your answer to instantly see the correct choice and a clear explanation, so you learn as you go. REVIEW MODE Missed questions are collected automatically so you can focus on your weak spots and turn them into strengths. BOOKMARKS Save important or tricky questions to revisit later and build your own focused review set. STUDY STATISTICS Track accuracy by study area with simple charts, so you always know which topics need more work before exam day. MOCK EXAM & RANDOM MODE Practice by topic, shuffle a random set, or take a timed-style mock exam to simulate the real test. WORKS OFFLINE All questions live inside the app, with no internet connection required. Your progress is saved privately on your device. Light and dark mode included. Start studying today and build the distributed SQL database knowledge to pass your PingCAP Certified TiDB Associate exam with confidence.

6784174120.name: Fit Card - Share Your Workouts
6784174120.description: Fit Card turns your Apple Health workouts into clean, shareable cards — for social media, friends, or anyone you want to show. Pick a recent workout, a Today, This Week, This Month, or This Year summary, or compare against Yesterday, Last Week, Last Month, and Last Year — and Fit Card builds a card with your stats. Then make it yours and share it in seconds. HOW IT WORKS 1. Connect Apple Health so Fit Card can read your workouts. 2. Tap a workout or summary to open the card editor. 3. Customize the background, stats, color, and font. 4. Export the image or send it straight to Instagram Stories. CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING Backgrounds: gradient and mesh presets, your own photos, a route map, or Apple Music album artwork. Stats: choose which metrics appear and in what order — calories, distance, heart rate, steps, pace, and more. Style: pick any installed font (favorite your go-to picks for quick access), set a text color, or use colors pulled from your photo. Aspect ratios: 1:1, 3:4, and 9:16 for Stories. Add an optional heart-rate graph. SHARE IN A TAP Double tap any share card — or use the context menu — to instantly save or copy it. Build and send a card right from the Messages app with the Fit Card iMessage extension — same editor, same customization, no app switching. Ask Siri, run a Shortcut, or search Spotlight to share your latest workout, today's card, or any past-period comparison instantly. Add a Quick Share control to Control Center for one-tap sharing from anywhere. STAY IN THE LOOP Finish a workout and get a quick notification to share it — you choose exactly which workout types notify you. Set a daily step goal and Fit Card tracks your progress in the background, sending a personalized notification the moment you cross it — no need to open the app and check. AT A GLANCE Add the Fit Card heat map widget to your Home Screen to see your workout activity at a glance, in small, medium, large, and extra-large sizes. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Fit Card reads from Apple Health only and never writes your data. Your workouts stay on your device. Make every workout worth sharing. privacy policy: https://rspoon3.com/fit-card/privacy

6762019524.name: Open Pi - Raspberry Pi Manager
6762019524.description: Direct, local, and private Raspberry Pi management. Open Pi lets you monitor system health, manage Docker containers, and run SSH commands on your Raspberry Pi right from your phone. No cloud servers, accounts, or subscriptions. Built for homelabs, self-hosting, IoT projects, and software development. Key Features System Health: Real-time CPU, RAM, storage, and temperature metrics Docker Management: View, start, stop, and restart containers Terminal: Secure SSH command-line access over local network or VPN File Manager: Direct file uploads and downloads GPIO Control: Monitor and toggle pins Auto-Discovery: Detect devices automatically on local networks System Actions: Wake-on-LAN helper, remote reboot, and alerts Privacy Native SSH connection with no background agents No accounts, tracking, or telemetry Local-first architecture with zero subscriptions All data stays on your local network

6786344049.name: VibeSDR
6786344049.description: VibeSDR is a mobile-first software-defined radio (SDR) receiver — and far more than a single-server client. It speaks multiple SDR server protocols and does its own demodulation of the raw IQ with a clean-room DSP engine. Pair that with a GPU-rendered waterfall, native background audio, on-device decoders and maps, plus voice and in-car control, for a genuinely great SDR experience on any iPhone — whatever receiver is behind it. WHAT YOU CAN CONNECT TO Remote SDR servers — native support for UberSDR, OpenWebRX / OpenWebRX+, and KiwiSDR, all behind one interface, with a directory chooser in the instance picker. Networked rtl_tcp — connect to a remote rtl_tcp server and VibeSDR demodulates the raw IQ itself. DISPLAY & WATERFALL Custom GPU waterfall and spectrum, rendered with a Skia shader for a smooth, high-frame-rate display independent of the server. Portrait and landscape layouts, ProMotion 120 Hz, haptic tuning feedback. Classic colour palettes (GQRX, KiwiSDR, CuteSDR, SdrDx, OpenWebRX), VFO glow controls, and a spectrum backdrop image. TUNING & CONTROLS VFO drum with inertia scrolling and a dual-drum waterfall zoom. Full mode set — USB, LSB, AM, SAM, FM, NFM, CW — with passband sliders. Noise reduction, noise blanker, squelch, AGC, volume and mute. AUDIO Native audio engines running outside any WebView, so playback survives app suspension. Background audio on both platforms. Lock-screen, Now Playing, CarPlay and Apple Watch controls with frequency + station metadata and station/bookmark skipping. AAC recorder with share sheet. VOICE CONTROL Siri — "Hey Siri, tune VibeSDR" then a frequency, a station name, or a band; it tunes with the right demodulator and step, even in the background over headphones, CarPlay or the lock screen. DECODERS & MAPS On-device decoders — RTTY, NAVTEX, WEFAX, SSTV, Morse, and speech-to-text. Server maps — HFDL aircraft, digital and CW activity maps, fully embedded. STATIONS & BOOKMARKS Instance picker directory across UberSDR, OpenWebRX/OpenWebRX+ and KiwiSDR receivers, with country flags, favourites and an auto-connect default. Bookmark and band-plan search with live EiBi schedules. Visual Tuning System (VTS) — nearby-station bar, band-crossing popups and station skipping. Live chat, and Share a tuned station as a tappable deep link. NEW: DEEP LINKING Tap a vibesdr:// link to connect straight to a receiver and tune to the shared frequency — no hunting through the picker. VibeSDR is free software under the GNU GPL-3.0, built by Stuart Carr with AI assistance from Claude (Anthropic). VibeSDR is a receiver client and is not affiliated with the SDR servers it connects to.

6783872393.name: OpenWebUI - Mobile
6783872393.description: OpenWebUI 客户端是一款为你自己的 Open WebUI 服务器打造的原生应用——像使用真正的应用一样流畅地与你的 AI 模型聊天，同时把一切都保留在你的服务器上，尽在你的掌控之中。 功能特点 与你的模型聊天，实时(流式)回复 在 Open WebUI 中配置的多种提供方与模型 图像生成 笔记与知识库(RAG) 语音模式:开口说话，听取回复 聊天操作:置顶、归档、重命名、克隆、分享与导出 主题与个性化 附件:发送照片和文件 应用支持 34 种语言，随设备自动识别 隐私 应用只与你指定的 Open WebUI 服务器通信。不经过任何第三方——你的数据始终留在你的服务器上。 使用要求 你需要拥有一台可访问的 Open WebUI 服务器。首次启动时，输入服务器地址并使用你的账户登录。 本应用是独立客户端，与 Open WebUI 项目无隶属关系。

6793384013.name: 密码证件夹
6793384013.description: 安全保存你的账号密码、身份证、银行卡、护照等重要信息。 密码证件夹是一款专注于隐私保护的本地密码管理工具，无需注册账号，不上传云端，所有数据仅保存在你的设备中，让重要信息真正掌握在自己手里。 无论是日常使用的账号密码，还是身份证、驾驶证、银行卡、护照等重要证件，都可以统一整理、分类保存，随时快速查找。 主要功能 账号密码管理 保存各类账号密码，支持用户名、邮箱、网址、备注等信息，一键复制账号或密码，分类管理更加清晰。 证件管理 支持保存身份证、银行卡、驾驶证、护照、社保卡、医保卡、工作证、学生证、会员卡以及其他各类重要证件。 支持添加证件照片、证件号码、有效期、备注等信息。 快速搜索 快速搜索账号、证件名称或备注内容，重要信息一秒找到。 分类整理 根据不同用途进行分类管理，让账号密码和证件信息更加整洁有序。 本地离线存储 所有数据均保存在你的设备中，不上传服务器，不同步到云端，离线也可正常使用。 为什么选择密码证件夹？ 本地离线存储 数据不上云 无广告 无订阅 无需注册账号 操作简单，打开即用 适用场景 保存账号密码 保存身份证信息 保存银行卡信息 保存护照信息 保存驾驶证信息 保存会员卡信息 管理各类证件 管理个人隐私信息 让所有重要信息，都有一个安全、可靠、易查找的地方。 隐私协议：https://xiaohao7023.github.io/password-wallet-ids-legal/privacy.html 用户协议：https://xiaohao7023.github.io/password-wallet-ids-legal/terms.html

6758302945.name: SoundScope: Audio Analyzer
6758302945.description: 看见你的声音。 SoundScope 把你的 iPhone 和 iPad 变成一台完整的音频分析仪——以广播级精度测量频谱、响度、立体声声场与动态，并呈现在惊艳的拉丝金属界面中。 无论你是在混音、母带、跑现场、校准房间，还是单纯喜欢看音乐"呼吸"，SoundScope 都能让你看见耳朵单独听不出的东西，并告诉你如何修正。 — 看见声音的四种方式 — 频谱：高分辨率实时分析仪，柱状或顺滑的线条模式，动画峰值保持，20 至 120 个频段，对数或线性刻度 声谱图：滚动的瀑布图，配以绚丽的 inferno 热力图，20 Hz 至 20 kHz RADIAL BLOOM：随节拍脉动内核的环形氛围分析仪 RIBBON TUNNEL：镜像霓虹光带，把你的桌面变成指挥中心 — 广播级响度 — 完整的 ITU-R BS.1770 套件：Momentary、Short-term 与带门限的 Integrated LUFS、响度范围（LRA）、采样间 True Peak（dBTP）以及 DR 动态评分。在上传"之前"就精确知道自己的响度，而不是之后。 — 口袋里的混音师 — 内置诊断引擎与你一同聆听，用大白话告诉你：削波警告、响度战争提醒、被压扁的动态、单声道低频抵消以及频率平衡问题——依据 EDM、嘻哈、摇滚、古典、原声与播客的流派档案进行判断。它甚至会告诉你 Spotify、YouTube 等平台会把你的曲目调低多少。 — 读懂立体声声场 — 带峰值保持的立体声 VU 表、实时立体声图像显示、Mid/Side 频谱以及相位相关表。从超低频到空气频段的分频段 RMS，还有单声道兼容条，精确显示你的混音在单声道下会在哪里崩塌。 — 精准操控 — FFT 大小从 64 到 131,072，配 TRANS / BAL / MASTR 预设，重叠率高达 93.75%，HOLD 冻结任意瞬间，输入灵敏度 0.1x 至 4x。 — 任何声音。零设置。 — 对准你的监听音箱、现场 PA、乐器或正在播放的曲目——通过内置麦克风或任意连接的音频接口。竖屏用于完整测量，横屏用于分析仪。 — 为长久使用而设计 — 一台奢华的拉丝金属仪器，配触感操控、触觉反馈与八种强调色——含随频率上色的实时"频谱"彩虹。完整支持深色模式与减弱动态效果。 — 完美适合 — 录音师、制作人与母带工程师 现场扩声与 FOH 工程师 音乐人、歌手与播客主 声学工程师、安装人员与教育者 每一个认真对待声音的人 无订阅。无账户。无需登录。无遥测。一切都在设备上离线运行，采用 Apple 原生工程，在 iPhone 和 iPad 上始终顺滑如丝。 别再靠猜。开始看见。 下载 SoundScope，用眼睛聆听。

6776190200.name: Drawloft
6776190200.description: Drawloft is a polished random picker and fair-draw toolkit for classrooms, events, family decisions, game night, team splits, and organizer-run giveaways. Spin a tactile wheel, draw names without repeats, roll dice, flip a coin, pick random numbers, split teams, shuffle a presentation order, and now build a Draw Runbook before the draw starts. Everything works locally on your iPhone or iPad with no account, no ads, no tracking, and no internet requirement. DRAW RUNBOOK Plan the draw before you run it: Choose a session type such as classroom, giveaway, tournament, meeting, or game night. Set winner and alternate counts. Turn on no-repeats, weighted entries, and fair-draw proof options. Review readiness checks before the draw begins. Share a clean run order with participants or co-hosts. FAIR DRAW PROOF Drawloft helps hosts explain how a result was produced: Optional public seed labels for transparent draws. Separate checks for no-repeats, weighted entries, alternates, and organizer rules. A shareable summary after the runbook is ready. Clear reminders that organizer-run giveaways need their own official rules and that Apple is not a sponsor. THE WHEEL THAT FEELS REAL Physics-inspired spin motion that slows naturally. Crisp ticks, haptics, and confetti. Weighted choices with optional visual wedge sizing. Fast editing for colors, labels, and odds. TRUE NO-REPEAT NAME DRAWS Great for teachers, hosts, clubs, and families: Nobody is picked twice until the full pool is exhausted. Draw one winner, several winners, or alternates. Reset the pool when you are ready for another round. Keep a local history when you want an audit trail. DICE, COINS, NUMBERS, TEAMS Roll common dice or custom dice. Use dice expressions such as 2d6+3 or 4d6k3. Flip a customizable coin with a running tally. Pick unique random numbers. Split saved lists into balanced teams. Shuffle a complete order for turns, presentations, bracket seeds, or chores. SAVE LISTS ONCE Create rosters, prize pools, chores, menus, teams, and clubs. Bulk-paste names. Duplicate and recolor lists. Export results as plain text or CSV. Use built-in starter templates when you need a quick pool. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Drawloft is local-first. Your lists and draw history stay on your device. The app does not use accounts, analytics, ads, tracking, or a developer backend. Drawloft is a decision and fair-draw utility. It is not gambling software and should not be used for regulated lotteries, wagers, or legally binding contests. Event organizers are responsible for their own rules, eligibility, prize terms, and legal compliance.

6743432117.name: 文字落下 for Safari
6743432117.description: 此Safari扩展可立即将选定的网页文本保存为文本文件。无需复制粘贴或打开文本编辑器——只需一键下载。如果未选择任何文本，它会自动检测并保存主要内容。一个简单工具，助力高效工作流程。 最初设计用于翻译或总结非母语文本，避免在使用绕过令牌限制的生成式AI服务时反复复制粘贴的麻烦，此扩展生成通用的纯文本文件，而非格式化笔记。这为您提供了完全的灵活性，可将捕获的内容用于任何应用程序、AI服务或文本处理工具，不受格式限制。非常适合研究人员、开发者、学生和日常用户，他们需要以最兼容的格式获取网页内容，以实现最大的便携性和多功能性。

6792259260.name: 闪记托福
6792259260.description: 每一次亮屏，都是一次学习。 准备托福，真正困难的往往不是开始，而是在课程、工作和生活之间保持稳定的复习节奏。闪记托福希望把那些容易被忽略的碎片时间重新交还给学习：等车时看一个词，课间听一次发音，睡前在锁屏再遇见一次。你不必强迫自己一次记住很多，只需要让记忆在每天的生活里持续发生。 【为托福备考建立的词汇系统】 闪记托福精选 2234 个高频托福词汇，覆盖 Reading、Listening、Speaking、Writing 四项技能，并结合校园生活、生命科学、环境与地球科学、社会科学、教育与心理、科技与工程、商业与经济、历史与文明、艺术与文化及通用学术等领域进行分类。 每个词都设有一个主技能，同时标注其他适用技能、学术领域以及校园或学术语境。你可以按照自己的备考阶段，集中练习阅读词汇、听力词汇、口语表达或写作词汇，也可以按学科领域逐步扩展词汇储备。 针对托福考试中常见的校园交流场景，词库特别强化了课程注册、退课与加课、教授答疑时间、图书馆借阅、宿舍住宿、校园餐饮、奖学金、学生社团和校园服务等高频表达，让词汇不仅停留在释义上，也能进入实际使用场景。 【每张词卡都包含】 清晰的英文单词、词性与中文释义 美式系统发音与国际音标 四技能主分类及适用技能标签 校园或学术语境标记 对应的学术领域分类 一句“TOEFL考试语境再现”英文例句 与英文语境逐句对应的中文翻译 例句不是简单告诉你“这个词出现在哪里”，而是让目标词直接承担句子中的真实语法和语义作用，帮助你理解它在课堂讲座、校园对话、阅读文章、口语回答和学术写作中的自然用法。 【让锁屏也参与复习】 除了主 App 中的完整单词卡，闪记托福还提供锁屏小组件与全宽锁屏词条。 添加锁屏小组件后，你可以在不进入 App 的情况下查看当前单词和中文释义，并通过箭头切换下一词。开启全宽锁屏词条后，还可以直接在锁屏上标记掌握或继续学习下一个词。 支持 1、5、15、30 分钟轮换设置，让单词以更轻量的方式反复出现。主 App、锁屏小组件、全宽锁屏词条和掌握记录使用同一套稳定顺序，避免学习进度错位。 【稳定乱序，而不是机械背表】 词库保留词频参考信息，同时采用稳定乱序进行实际学习，帮助减少相邻词汇之间的短期位置记忆。你看到的学习顺序不会简单按照字母排列，也不会在每次打开 App 时完全变化，让交叉复习和长期进度能够保持一致。 你可以随时标记或取消掌握，在“我的”页面查看整体进度、四技能掌握度以及不同学术领域的学习情况。所有进度都只属于你自己，也只保存在你的设备上。 【离线、安静、没有打扰】 无需注册或登录 无广告、无分析、无用户追踪 不调用第三方 AI 服务 不依赖联网词典 不请求麦克风权限 学习进度仅保存在设备本地 一次购买，无订阅、无 App 内购买 闪记托福不要求你一次学习很久，也不希望用连续签到制造新的压力。它更像一个安静的学习伙伴，在那些原本可能被忽略的几秒钟里，陪你多听一次、多看一眼、多记住一个词。 当一次次微小的复习慢慢积累，每一次亮屏，都会让你离自己的目标更近一点。

6784708800.name: 榫卯结构3D-传统木作三维研习
6784708800.trackName: 榫卯结构3D-传统木作三维研习
6784708800.description: 「榫卯结构3D」是一款面向中国传统木作爱好者的学习与探索应用，以榫卯结构为核心，用三维交互与系统内容，帮助用户真正看懂、学会、记住这门千年技艺。 应用收录直榫、燕尾榫、透榫、粽角榫等二十余种经典形式，涵盖基础接合、家具构造与古建应用等分类。每种榫卯均提供别名、用途、制作步骤、优缺点及典型器物应用，并配备可交互的三维模型：单指旋转、双指缩放，还可查看爆炸拆解与装配演示，从任意角度观察榫头与卯眼的配合关系，理解结构如何咬合、传力与稳固。 学习中心提供五步系统路线、二十余条专业术语词典、并排对比与多套专题测验，配合经典案例拆解与每日精选推荐，适合零基础入门，也便于从业者查漏补缺。图库支持分类浏览与关键词搜索，个人收藏、浏览记录与学习笔记则帮你沉淀每一次收获。 无论你是木工学徒、古建研究者，还是对传统家具心怀兴趣的普通人，都能在这里把抽象的名称化为立体的结构，在指尖转动之间，感受木作工艺里蕴含的力学智慧与匠人精神。

6792228018.name: 专注食光fodcus:工作学习番茄钟
6792228018.trackName: 专注食光fodcus:工作学习番茄钟
6792228018.description: 专注食光是一个番茄钟软件。开始专注前，你先进行“点单”，从app内的5类26种食物中选择自己想要的。你可以选择“立即送达”，下单后立即开始专注，你也可以选择“预约配送”，选择未来的时间进行预约专注。预约的专注时间到时，app会向你发送通知，提醒你开始。 专注时，没一分钟都可以获得一个专注点数，若点数多于你点的食物所需，就可以将点数存入账户内。专注时不要提前退出哦！提前退出会扣除20点数，也无法获得所点的食物。 专注结束后，你会获得你点的食物、这个食物获得的饱腹度以及一张它对应的贴纸。饱腹度达到百分之百会解锁成就，而贴纸则可以在贴纸池中使用。 app还有日程表功能，上面有每日的专注时间、获得的食物以及未来预约专注活动的记录。 加入专注食光，收获高效的时光！

6768206382.name: WaveRhythm - 挥光律动
6768206382.description: WaveRhythm – 挥光律动 – 让音乐与挥手驱动的光影装置 把你的 iPhone 变成一块能跟随音乐节拍和挥手动作变幻的色彩面板。无论是演唱会现场应援、家中律动舞池，还是营造柔和氛围光，挥光律动都能用丝滑的节奏光影铺满屏幕。 主要功能: 音乐律动模式 – 通过麦克风感知环境声音强度，屏幕颜色随节拍、和弦、副歌自然变化。 挥手律动模式 – 像挥动应援棒一样有节奏地摆动手机，利用运动传感器触发颜色跳变，无需相机。 9 种预设场景 – 自然光、暖阳、冷月、柔光、少女感、柔滑、雪晶、幻紫、科技蓝，每种都精心调校了亮度、饱和度与色相。 多种变色方式 – 随机色相、随机场景、正向有序色相、正向有序场景、反向有序色相/场景，灯光秀流动由你掌控。 全手动调色 – 随时拖动滑块独立调节色相、饱和度与亮度，创造专属色彩。 灵敏调节 – 可分别设置音乐与挥手模式的触发阈值、冷却时间、动画速度，支持每次触发时的触觉反馈。 极简交互 – 轻点屏幕可隐藏所有控制界面，专注于沉浸式观感；左右滑动快速切换场景，上下滑动调节设备亮度。 适用场景: 演唱会应援、听歌节奏灯、派对气氛灯、直播补光、婴儿夜灯、卧室氛围灯等。 注意: 音乐律动模式需获取麦克风权限（仅用于本地实时分析音量大小，绝不录音或存储）。挥手律动模式使用设备运动与方向数据。 下载WaveRhythm – 挥光律动，让光影在掌心随心律动！

6761850094.description: Export your Apple Health workouts as clean, usable files — and review your routes, charts, and progress in one place. Workout Exporter lets you pull detailed workout data from Apple Health, save it in practical formats, and analyze both individual workouts and long-term training trends directly on your device. Export Formats JSON — full, lossless HealthKit workout data for custom analysis and development GPX — GPS routes with heart rate for mapping tools and route apps TCX — complete workout exports for Strava, Garmin Connect, TrainingPeaks, and other fitness platforms CSV — summary tables and raw time-series sample exports PDF — polished workout and progress reports with charts, stats, and route maps when available Workout Detail View route maps for GPS-based workouts Inspect interactive overlaid charts for metrics like heart rate, pace, speed, power, and cadence Review workout summaries, device details, and per-series stats Progress Tracking Track duration, distance, average speed, and energy over time Filter by preset time periods or custom date ranges Export progress chart data as JSON, CSV, or PDF No account required. No subscription. No data leaves your device unless you choose to export it. Built for athletes, developers, analysts, and anyone who wants full control over their workout data.

6784252522.name: 我要早睡
6784252522.description: 断开，是为了更好地链接。晚安世界！ 「我要早睡」是一款温和而坚定的自律工具。它帮助你在自己设定的时间段内，屏蔽那些让你熬夜刷到停不下来的 App 和网页，把夜晚还给睡眠，把清晨还给自己。 1. 它怎么帮你早睡 设定一个“限制时段”——比如晚上 23:00 到早上 6:00 从系统列表里勾选你想屏蔽的 App、App 类别或网站 点击“开始限制”，到点自动生效，时段结束自动解除 电话和短信默认不被屏蔽，紧急沟通始终畅通 2. 真正的自律助手 限制进行中，“停止”按钮会被有意锁定——这不是 Bug，而是设计的核心：在你最容易被冲动打败的那几分钟，App 替你守住边界。当然，你始终可以通过系统「设置 → 屏幕使用时间」撤销授权来紧急解除。 3. 隐私第一 无需注册，无需登录，无账号体系 不收集、不上传、不分享任何个人数据 你选择屏蔽哪些 App，系统以不透明令牌的形式保存在本机，App 自身也无法读出“你具体选了哪些 App” 不含任何第三方 SDK、广告或追踪工具 包含完整的 PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy 隐私清单 4. 基于系统原生能力，稳定可靠 本 App 使用 Apple 提供的「屏幕使用时间」（Family Controls / Screen Time API）框架实现屏蔽功能。首次使用时系统会弹出授权请求，轻点“允许”即可。该授权仅用于自我管理，不是家长控制工具。 5. 适合这样的你 晚上说好要睡，结果刷短视频到凌晨两点的你 想减少屏幕时间、改善作息的你 希望有一个“温柔但守信用”的工具来帮助自律的你 「我要早睡」不是冷冰冰的锁，而是一个你自己为自己设定的、说到做到的承诺。晚安，好梦。

6760890995.name: 专注旅程 - 沉浸式飞机高铁番茄钟
6760890995.trackName: 专注旅程 - 沉浸式飞机高铁番茄钟
6760890995.description: 「专注旅程」专注旅程是一款主打沉浸式心流体验与专注力提升的工具，通过模拟飞机与高铁的真实航旅场景，帮助用户在极具仪式感的时空穿梭中高效完成深度工作与学习。 只需选好目的地和座位，戴上耳机，随着窗外风景的变幻，那些让人分心的消息和焦虑都会被抛在脑后。当你顺利“抵达”时，手头上的任务也刚好圆满完成。 核心功能 1. 独创双重出行场景（飞机 + 高铁） 随心选择： 告别单一的倒计时界面，你可以自由选择搭乘万米高空的航班，或是乘坐贴地飞行的高铁。 专属窗景： 不同的出行方式配备了专属的动态视觉窗景。是看云海翻涌，还是看田野掠过，都由你当下的心情决定。 2. 沉浸式白噪音，一秒进入心流 真实采样： 内置高品质的场景白噪音。无论是机舱内平稳的低频轰鸣，还是高铁车厢里规律轻快的轨道“咔哒”声，都能迅速帮你建立起一道声音屏障。 隔绝干扰： 配合专注模式，有效隔绝外界嘈杂与手机通知，让你在舒适的白噪音包裹中，不知不觉完成深度工作。 3. 充满仪式感的成长轨迹与专属票根 可视化进度： 专注过程中，你可以在 3D 实时地图上清晰地看到自己正从“出发地”向“目的地”平稳移动，让枯燥的时间流逝变得具体可见。 专属纪念： 每完成一次专注，系统都会为你生成一张极具设计感的专属“登机牌”或“高铁票”。它不仅记录了你的专注时长和任务类型，更是你每一次努力和成长的见证。 隐私政策：https://privacy.minecaller.com/journey/privacy_zhcn_ios.html 用户协议：https://privacy.minecaller.com/journey/EULA_zhcn_ios.html 会员服务协议： https://privacy.minecaller.com/journey/vip_service_ios.html

6746743523.name: LX - Light Meter

6777319489.name: Subscription Tracker: Submindo
6777319489.description: 别再为忘掉的订阅白花钱。Submindo 是会在每次扣款前提醒你的订阅管理工具，还能用 AI 找出被浪费的开支。 Netflix、Spotify、iCloud、健身房，或任何 SaaS 工具 —— Submindo 把所有周期性扣款集中到一处，让你的账户不再被突然扣款。 SUBMINDO 能做什么 记录每一个订阅 输入名称、价格、货币、扣款周期和开始日期即可添加任意订阅。支持按日、按周、按月、按年的周期。登记免费试用期，在被扣款前及时取消。 智能账单提醒 不再错过任何续费。自己决定提前几天收到提醒，通知会准时送达 —— 告别意外扣款。 扣款日历 在可视化日历上查看即将到来的所有扣款。一眼看出开销集中的月份，在钱花出去之前做好预算。 支出汇总 按日、周、月、年查看订阅总支出。任何时间段内，周期性付款花了多少钱都一清二楚。 AI 支出分析 为你的全部订阅生成效率评分。Submindo 的 AI 会发现重叠的套餐、标出冗余服务、指出花费过高的项目，并给出明确结论：值得 / 一般 / 不值得，同时按优先级给出改进建议。 AI 替代方案推荐 是不是付多了？Submindo 会为每个订阅找到价值相同但更便宜的方案，并排比较价格，直接算出每月能省多少，让你马上行动。 13 个支出分类 按娱乐、AI、云服务、金融、健康、教育、效率、社交媒体、通信、开发、新闻、生活缴费等分类整理。 完整付款记录 查看每个订阅的完整付款历史 —— 什么时候付了多少，始终清清楚楚。 别再多付钱，从记录开始。 大多数人手里有 5–10 个几乎不再想起的订阅，每一次被遗忘的续费都是白花的钱。Submindo 让每笔周期性账单都看得见，每条提醒都准时，每笔花费都经过 AI 检验。 下载 Submindo —— 为想彻底掌控周期性开支的人打造的订阅与支出管理工具。 SUBMINDO 高级版 升级高级版可解锁无限订阅、AI 支出分析和 AI 替代方案推荐。提供按月订阅和一次性买断的终身版。 免费版：最多记录 3 个订阅，提醒、日历、支出汇总。 高级版：无限订阅 + 全部 AI 功能。 购买确认时将通过你的 Apple ID 扣款。按月订阅会自动续期，除非在当前周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭；你可以随时在 App Store 账户设置中管理或取消。终身版为一次性购买，不会续费。 条款：https://www.submindo.app/terms 隐私政策：https://www.submindo.app/privacy

6755193261.name: CalmPets Dog Cat Calming Music
6755193261.description: Every pet deserves calm. CalmPets is a collection of carefully designed sounds created to help cats and dogs relax, reduce stress, and sleep more peacefully. Whether it’s during bedtime, while you’re away, or when the world feels a bit too loud — CalmPets brings comfort through sound. Perfect for: Helping your pet unwind before sleep Easing separation or travel anxiety Creating a calm space during storms or loud environments Building a peaceful daily routine Features: Unique calming sounds crafted for both cats and dogs Continuous, looped playback for long naps and nighttime use Minimal, distraction-free design Works seamlessly in the background while you relax together CalmPets turns ordinary moments into moments of peace — helping your furry friend rest better, feel safer, and stay calm through the sounds they love most. Whether it’s a short nap or a long night’s sleep, CalmPets is here to bring serenity to every heartbeat. 6788695912.name: 数控车工计算器-车床加工中心编程计算
6788695912.trackName: 数控车工计算器-车床加工中心编程计算
6788695912.description: 数控车工计算器是一款面向数控车工、机械加工从业者及相关学习人员的实用计算工具，帮助用户在加工准备、参数查询和公式学习中提升效率。 应用内置多种常用车工计算功能，包括切点计算、螺纹计算、宏程序、切槽编程、锥度计算、三角函数等，适用于日常加工参数计算与编程辅助参考。 同时，应用提供实用工具箱，支持公差查询、G 代码查询、车削公式、铣削公式、钻孔公式等内容，方便用户快速查找常见加工知识。公式模块清晰展示主轴转速、切削速度、进给量、背吃刀量等常用计算方式，并附带参数说明和单位说明，便于理解和使用。 螺纹参数表支持查看公制粗牙螺纹、公制细牙螺纹、美制粗牙等常见规格参数，包括螺距、大径、内螺纹小径、推荐钻头等信息，方便加工前快速核对。 无论是数控车床加工、机械编程学习，还是车间现场参数查询，数控车工计算器都能为你提供便捷、清晰的计算与参考支持。应用内容仅作为机械加工学习和辅助计算参考，实际加工请结合设备、材料、刀具及工艺要求进行确认。

6761095884.name: VU Meter Pro
6761095884.description: VU Meter Pro is a professional audio metering app for broadcast, streaming, and live sound. It combines an analog VU meter with a loudness meter, phase meter, LED bar meter, and waveform display. Arrange the meters you need on screen to match each on-site workflow. Connect any USB class-compliant device (audio interface, mixer, recorder, or the audio output of a camera or switcher) with a single USB cable and start measuring right away. Use it as a portable meter in the field, or as a fixed tool in the studio. Works on both iPhone and iPad. What it measures Audio level (analog VU meter / LED bar) Loudness (Momentary / Short-term / Integrated / True Peak / LRA) Loudness history (graph display, up to 24 hours) Waveform (Waveform Scope, up to 30-minute history, pinch-to-zoom) Phase (Lissajous + correlation meter) Standards-based measurement Loudness measurement follows ITU-R BS.1770 and conforms to EBU R128 / EBU Mode (Tech 3341 and 3342) and ARIB TR-B32, at 48 and 96 kHz. Measurements are verified against reference signals. ITU-R BS.1770 is the measurement standard widely adopted by national broadcast loudness practices such as ATSC A/85 (US) and OP-59 (Australia), which target −24 LKFS. Loudness presets set the target and the True Peak limit in one tap: ARIB TR-B32, EBU R128, ATSC A/85 and OP-59 for broadcast, plus Spotify, YouTube and Apple Podcasts for streaming. Built for the field Responsive, real-time metering Standard and wide-range VU scales (−20 to +3 / −40 to +10) Seven meter themes for different lighting conditions and preferences LED bar colors: four presets, or set your own three zone colors Peak Indicator with an adjustable True Peak threshold, so you can tell at a glance whether a peak occurred Input Trim (±5 dB) for level calibration Peak-hold readouts for easy reading at a glance Launch and measure. No setup required. This app is built and maintained by a working engineer in radio, audio, and video production, for use in the field. Visibility and operational reliability are the top priorities. Use with an external audio interface. The built-in microphone is not suitable for accurate measurement.

6787955682.name: FitSync sync FIT to Health
6787955682.description: FitSync puts your bike rides into Apple Health — no fuss, no duplicate imports. Export a ride as a FIT file from SuperCycle (or any bike computer), share it with FitSync, and it lands in Apple Health as a full work-out — with the route on the map, distance, calories and, if you paired sensors, heart rate, power and cadence. WHY FITSYNC Never duplicated. FitSync identifies a ride by its start time, not its file name. Share the same ride twice or re-export it, and you always get exactly one work-out. No inflated weekly totals. Yours alone. No account, no server, no cloud. FitSync runs entirely on your iPhone and writes only to Apple Health. Your health data is never shared, sold or used for advertising. The whole ride. Route, distance, calories, heart rate, power and cadence — whatever the FIT file holds lands cleanly in Health. Fast and light. Share a ride and the app opens straight to the import. No subscription, no ads. HOW IT WORKS 1. Open your ride in SuperCycle and export the FIT file. 2. Choose FitSync in the share sheet. 3. Tap "Sync all". Your ride is in Apple Health. Perfect for anyone riding with SuperCycle or another FIT bike computer who wants their rides neatly in Apple Health — without retyping and without duplicate work-outs. FitSync is a paid app: buy once, yours forever. No in-app purchases, no subscription.

6793050629.name: 口算出题神器
6793050629.description: 口算出题神器是一款专为家长和孩子设计的口算练习卷生成器。几秒钟就能生成一张排版整齐、可直接打印的算术练习卷，再也不用买重复堆叠的练习册。 【五种题型】 加法：a + b = ? 减法：a - b = ?（结果保证非负，适合低龄） 加减法：两种运算随机混合 填括号：( ) + b = c、a + ( ) = c 等四种位置，锻炼逆向思维 混合卷：以上全部题型随机混排，模拟综合练习 【自由定制】 最大数字 5–100：从 10 以内启蒙到 100 以内进阶 题目数量 10–200：课后小练或整页大卷都可以 随机种子：输入同一个数字，随时复现同一份卷子，方便多孩子共用或重复练习 【一键打印】 内置 AirPrint：题目卷自动排版为 A4 页面（4 列 × 15 行），题号清晰、自带页码 一键生成 PDF 发送给打印机，也可以分享给家人 【家长放心】 完全离线：没有服务器，不上传任何数据 没有广告、没有内购、没有追踪 自带答案页：对照批改一目了然 适合 4–10 岁孩子的日常口算训练，也是老师快速出题的好帮手。

6791969349.name: Kompute - Music Calculator
6791969349.description: Kompute gives you 10 precision tools for studio math, all in one app. TAP TEMPO + METRONOME Tap to detect BPM with decimal precision. Built-in metronome. Round to nearest whole BPM or keep the exact reading. DELAY TIME TABLE Enter a BPM and see tempo-synced delay times for 21 note divisions. Normal, dotted, and triplet values in both milliseconds and Hz. NOTE TO FREQUENCY Convert any musical note to Hz. Supports 100+ temperaments beyond standard equal temperament. Adjustable concert pitch. Audio preview per note. FREQUENCY TO NOTE Enter a frequency, find the closest musical note with cents deviation. Identify the pitch of any sound. SAMPLE LENGTH CONVERTER Bidirectional conversion between samples, milliseconds, seconds, bars, and beats. Edit any field, all others recalculate. TEMPO CHANGE CALCULATOR Calculate time-stretch ratio and transposition when changing from one tempo to another. Shows stretch percentage, tempo delta, and semitone shift. TIMECODE CALCULATOR Full timecode arithmetic for video and film. Add, subtract, and multiply timecodes. Supports 10 FPS formats including 23.976, 29.97 drop frame, and 59.94. REVERB PRE-DELAY Calculate tempo-synced pre-delay values. Small, medium, large, and hall presets. Keep your reverb rhythmically aligned. COMPRESSOR SYNC Tempo-synced attack and release times. Lock your dynamics processing to the groove. EQ REFERENCE CHART Visual reference of frequency ranges by instrument and tonal character. Sub-bass through brilliance, with descriptions. CROSS-MODULE DATA FLOW Detect a tempo via Tap Tempo and it automatically transfers to Delay Table, Reverb, and Compressor modules. No ads. No tracking. No account required. Works fully offline. From All The Machines.

6763530697.name: 小白学钢琴
6763530697.description: 「小白学钢琴」面向刚接触钢琴、想系统入门的朋友，把乐理、键盘与日常练习收进一个清晰好用的路径里。你不必一开始就啃大部头教材，应用用短章节讲清五线谱、拍号、音名与手型等核心概念，每章配有随堂测验，帮你确认真的听懂，再自然进入下一关。 认谱之外，应用提供虚拟键盘，让你随时对照谱上的音在键位上找感觉；节拍器则帮你稳住速度，把「准」放在「快」前面。曲谱小屋收录多首耳熟能详的入门片段，用易读的音名与节奏提示，方便你边弹边建立信心。练琴计时会把你的专注时间记下来，连续练习与章节进度一目了然，成就一点一滴看得见。 界面采用温暖的木色与象牙白为主调，阅读与操作都尽量轻松。你可以在设置里修改昵称、备份或恢复学习数据，换机也不必从零开始。无论你是想自娱自乐、陪孩子启蒙，还是为以后跟老师上课打基础，「小白学钢琴」都希望成为你手边那位耐心、不催促的入门同伴。打开它，给今天的自己一小段与钢琴相处的时光就好。

6772857601.name: Fontbridge：字体安装器
6772857601.description: Fontbridge 是一款专注于 iOS / iPadOS 字体安装、检查与管理的工具。你可以导入 TTF、OTF 或 ZIP 字体文件，快速生成 iOS 字体描述文件，并把字体安装到设备中，用于 Pages、Keynote、Numbers、Word、PowerPoint、Excel 以及其他支持系统字体的 App。 无论你是在写文档、做演示、处理多语言文本，还是需要让设计稿、课件、合同、简历中的字体正确显示，Fontbridge 都可以帮你更清楚地知道：哪些字体已经可用，哪些字体还缺失。 主要功能： ・导入 TTF、OTF 或 ZIP 字体文件 ・生成并安装 iOS 字体描述文件 ・管理已导入的字体文件 ・检查文档中使用的字体 ・查看字体是否已在当前设备可用 ・适用于 iPhone 和 iPad ・无需账号 ・无需订阅 Fontbridge 不会修改整个系统界面字体，也不会强制改变所有 App 的显示效果。安装后的字体会出现在支持“系统已安装字体”或“自定义字体”的 App 中。 适合这些场景： ・在 Pages、Keynote、Numbers 中使用指定字体 ・在 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 中编辑带字体要求的文件 ・检查文档是否缺少字体 ・处理中文、英文、日文、韩文等多语言排版 ・为写作、学习、办公和设计准备字体环境 Fontbridge 只做一件事：让 iPhone 和 iPad 上的字体安装与检查更清楚、更可控。 注意：字体是否显示，取决于 iOS / iPadOS 系统以及各个 App 自身的字体支持方式。部分 App 可能需要重新启动后才会显示新安装的字体。

6759764495.name: Talkio: AI Language Learning
6759764495.description: Talkio AI is your personal AI language tutor — built for speaking practice, not grammar drills. Whether you're a complete beginner or brushing up before a trip, Talkio puts you in real conversations from day one. WHAT YOU CAN DO Have natural back-and-forth conversations with an AI tutor Get instant pronunciation feedback after every response Practice 70+ languages and dialects, including regional variants Take a proficiency quiz to match the right difficulty to your level Review your conversations and track your progress over time 70+ LANGUAGES English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Mandarin, Arabic (Modern Standard + dialects), Hindi, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Danish, and dozens more — including less common languages like Swahili, Basque, Icelandic, and Georgian. HOW IT WORKS Pick a language, choose a topic or let the AI suggest one, and start talking. The AI responds naturally, corrects mistakes in context, and adapts to your level. No multiple-choice quizzes. No flashcards. Just conversation. SUBSCRIPTIONS Talkio AI offers a free trial followed by a monthly or annual subscription. Subscription details are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://www.talkio.ai/legal/privacy

6670568062.name: TruVideo - AI Detector
6670568062.description: Protect yourself from digital deception with TruVideo - a tool that identifies AI-generated content in photos and videos in real time on-device. Whether you're capturing live moments or analyzing existing media, TruVideo-AI Detector leverages advanced machine learning models to uncover AI-manipulated audio, images, and video elements—all processed entirely on-device for maximum privacy and speed. Key Features Instant AI Detection: Capture photos or video snippets and instantly analyze them for AI-generated or cloned elements, including deepfake audio, altered images, or video manipulations. 100% On-Device Processing: Your media never leaves your device—our AI models run entirely on your phone, ensuring total privacy and data security. Privacy First: No cloud processing, no third-party data sharing—TruVideo-AI Detector works offline to protect your sensitive information. Real-Time Insights: Quickly flag suspicious content in your captured media with fast, accurate detection. User-Friendly Interface: Easily capture and analyze media with a simple, intuitive UI designed for both personal and professional use. Whether you're a content creator, security professional, or concerned consumer, TruVideo-AI Detector empowers you with the tools to detect and defend against AI-generated manipulation in your media. Stay ahead of the digital curve with TruVideo-AI Detector!

6793772005.name: Pic Taker - 图片批量处理 & 加密图片
6793772005.trackName: Pic Taker - 图片批量处理 & 加密图片
6793772005.description: Pic Taker 是 iPhone、iPad 专用全离线本地图片批量处理工具，所有图片编辑、加密操作仅在本机运行，全程不上传任何照片至网络，彻底保护你的图片隐私。 一、一站式批量图片处理 一次导入多张照片，统一批量编辑，无需逐张操作，适配办公、自媒体、证件照、社交配图全场景： 尺寸缩放 & 证件照预设 支持百分比缩放、自定义像素尺寸；内置一寸 / 二寸 / 身份证 / 护照 / 签证等证件照模板，一键裁剪标准证件尺寸，自动居中裁切。 多格式互转 HEIC、JPG、PNG 自由转换，自定义图片质量，解决苹果照片跨设备打不开问题。 文字 / Logo 双重水印 批量添加文字水印（默认机密文案）、自定义品牌 Logo 水印，可调透明度、倾斜角度、九宫格位置，保护原创图片版权。 EXIF 隐私清除 一键移除照片 GPS 定位信息，也可完整保留 / 修改拍摄元数据，分享照片不再泄露拍摄地点。 二、独家加密照片隐藏功能（核心差异化卖点） 不想公开的私密照片、证件、工作机密图，一键打包生成专属.enc加密文件： 1、AES-256 高强度加密，自定义 8 位以上访问密码，支持密码提示 2、加密包仅 Pic Taker 可解密打开，其他 App 无法读取内部图片，完美隐藏私密照片 3、支持 Face ID 二次验证解密加密包，多重防护 4、加密文件可 AirDrop、微信、文件 App 传输，不用担心照片泄露 三、全方位隐私安全设计 100% 离线运行，无服务器、无数据上传、无广告、无追踪 SDK，不收集任何个人信息 仅读取相册权限，原图永久保存在系统相册，App 不会删除、覆盖原图 处理图片仅临时缓存，不自动留存；未手动保存 / 导出不会永久留存处理结果 App 自带应用锁，开启后打开 App 需 Face ID / 自定义密码，防止他人偷看图库 加密密码、应用密码仅本地 Keychain 加密存储，无明文留存，开发者无法获取 四、实用辅助功能 图片 EXIF 信息查看：尺寸、拍摄设备、时间、GPS 定位一键查看 处理历史记录保存，一键复用上次批量编辑参数 深色 / 浅色模式、简体 / 繁体 / 英文三语言自由切换 批量处理支持暂停、取消，单张失败不中断全部任务 处理完成一键保存相册、导出至文件 App、分享加密包 适用人群 自媒体创作者、电商运营、职场办公人员、摄影师、需要保存私密证件照、注重隐私保护的所有 iPhone/iPad 用户 产品承诺 全程本地处理，不上传一张图片；无订阅、无广告、无隐形扣费，纯净图片工具。

6763670875.name: Silicon Vault
6763670875.description: The Definitive Legacy Archive. Stop tracking your collection in messy spreadsheets. Silicon Vault is a premium database built by an enthusiast, for enthusiasts. Featuring over 600 pre-seeded Apple products spanning from the 1976 Apple I to the cutting-edge MacBooks; it’s the most comprehensive way to document your tech journey and love for the greatest company on earth, Apple. Key Features: Massive Pre-Seeded Database: Instantly find and add hardware from every era: Macintosh, iPod, iPhone, Apple Watch, Apple Polishing Cloth, and even the "hidden" gems like the Pippin and Newton. Ownership Tracking: Categorize your gear by multiple categories of ownership. Detailed Statistics: Visualize your collection health with a breakdown of your hardware and box inventory. Search & Filter: Find exactly what you’re looking for in seconds with lightning-fast global search.

6761335868.name: Cast Forge Studio
6761335868.description: Cast Forge Studio is the premium podcast and content creation studio built exclusively for the Apple ecosystem. Designed for solo podcasters, educators, consultants, and indie creators who take their craft seriously — it gives you a complete, professional workflow from first idea to final export, across every Apple device you own. PROJECTS & EPISODES Organise your work the way you think. Create projects for each show, series, or client. Inside every project, manage episodes from draft through to published — with titles, descriptions, notes, status tracking, and a full history of your recordings in one clean, focused space. No clutter. No compromise. RECORDING Capture ideas the moment they arrive. Record directly on iPhone, iPad, or Mac with a clean, distraction-free recording interface. Pause, resume, and review without ever leaving the app. Whether you're recording a full episode or a quick voice note, Cast Forge Studio gets out of your way and lets you focus on what you're saying. ON-DEVICE AI TRANSCRIPTION Every word you record can be transcribed automatically — privately, entirely on your device. There are no servers involved, no audio uploads, and no third-party processing. Using Apple's on-device Speech framework, Cast Forge Studio turns your recordings into accurate, searchable transcripts that stay under your control at all times. AI-ASSISTED METADATA Once your transcript is ready, Cast Forge Studio can help you generate titles, episode descriptions, and show notes — all powered by on-device Apple Intelligence. Every suggestion is editable before you use it. The AI assists; you decide. Your voice, your words, your show. CLIP & HIGHLIGHT STUDIO The best moments of your episode shouldn't be buried. Mark highlights directly from your recording or transcript, then export them as polished short-form clips — ready to share on social media. The timeline editor gives you precise control over in and out points, so every clip you export is exactly right. MULTITRACK & POST-PRODUCTION Layer multiple audio tracks for interviews, music beds, and sound design. The built-in post-production tools let you mix, trim, and arrange your episode with precision. Fine-tune levels, apply processing, and prepare a publication-ready file — all without leaving the app. ICLOUD SYNC Your projects and episode metadata sync automatically across iPhone, iPad, and Mac via CloudKit. Start a project on your iPhone, review it on your iPad, and finalise it on your Mac. Everything stays in step, privately, through your own iCloud account. No third-party cloud. No subscription required. DESIGNED FOR EVERY APPLE DEVICE Cast Forge Studio is a universal app built natively for iPhone, iPad, and Mac — not a phone app stretched to fit a bigger screen. Each platform gets the layout and controls that feel right for that device. iPhone for capture on the go. iPad for review and editing. Mac for organisation, finalisation, and export. PREMIUM BY DESIGN Cast Forge Studio is built to feel like professional software — because that's what serious creators deserve. Clean typography, precise controls, intentional whitespace, and a dark interface that keeps the focus on your content. No ads. No upsells. No unnecessary complexity. PRIVACY FIRST Your recordings are yours. All AI features run entirely on your device. No audio is ever transmitted to any server. No analytics SDKs. No tracking. Cast Forge Studio is built on the principle that a professional tool should respect the privacy of the work you create with it. REQUIREMENTS — iPhone: iOS 18 or later — iPad: iPadOS 18 or later — Mac: macOS 15 Sequoia or later (Apple Silicon or Intel) — iCloud account optional, required only for cross-device sync — Microphone access required for in-app recording

6779726272.trackName: 潘教练：掼蛋从入门到精通
6779726272.description: 潘教练不只让你打掼蛋，更帮助你理解每一步为什么这样打。 全新掼蛋学院 43 门课程全部开放，无需按顺序解锁 覆盖规则、组牌、战略、控牌、团队配合、对手分析、进贡还贡、残局与实战复盘 6 条推荐路线，适合新手入门、系统进阶和赛前强化 勋章与证书记录学习成果，不限制你自由探索 随时可查的本地 Wiki 105 个掼蛋知识点，支持规则、牌型和战术搜索 课程、Wiki、训练与教练复盘使用同一套知识体系 无网络也能快速查询关键规则 沉浸式 Unity 牌桌 清晰稳定的牌面尺寸与堆叠布局 支持点击、滑动多选、理牌、提示和恢复 四个座位拥有独立出牌区、倒计时和剩余牌提示 完整处理级牌、逢人配、进贡还贡、同花顺与炸弹规则 更懂牌局的 AI 教练 规则引擎先保证每个动作合法 ActionAnalyzer 比较候选动作，端侧神经评分提升推荐质量 提示、专项训练和复盘共用统一分析结果 每次复盘保留理由、标签和下一步训练建议，而不是只给一个答案 学习档案会记录课程、专项训练、对局与常见问题，帮助你看到真实进步。 现已支持 13 种界面语言。

6763278297.name: 小白学网球
6763278297.description: 「小白学网球」面向刚接触或想系统了解网球的朋友，把看似复杂的规则、术语和基础技术，拆成容易消化的小模块，让你不必东拼西凑资料，也能建立完整入门认知。 在内容安排上，应用从「看懂比赛」出发：用通俗说明配合图示，讲解计分、发球、场地分区等常见疑问，并配有术语对照，方便你对照直播或现场解说。动作学习部分以卡片形式呈现正手、反手、发球与截击等要点，配合步骤拆解与常见错误提示，帮助你在练习时心里有数、少走弯路。此外还有可跟练的入门训练计划、热身清单与训练日记，把「今天练了什么、感受如何」记下来，便于回顾与坚持。规则小测验与错题回顾，则适合用来巩固记忆、检验理解。 界面采用清爽的天蓝与明快的点缀色，卡片式布局阅读轻松，并适当加入动效与插画感元素，让学习过程不那么枯燥。应用内附娱乐向记分工具，方便和朋友打球时随手记一局胜负。 需要说明的是：文中所述规则与训练建议为通用入门参考，具体判罚与强度请以现场约定、教练指导及自身身体状况为准；运动前请充分热身，量力而行。 无论你是准备第一次上场，还是想把「看懂网球」这件事一次搞定，「小白学网球」都希望成为你手边随时可翻的入门小助手。

6787424936.name: 中小学生通识大师
6787424936.description: 中小学生通识大师 每天读一点，通识长一分。 这是一款专为小学到初中学生打造的通识知识学习应用。我们把孩子在成长阶段应知应会的常识，整理成六大板块、三个学段的知识点与配套习题，让孩子利用碎片时间轻松积累、稳步提升。 六大知识板块 中华历史通识：朝代更迭与历史人物 国学传统文化：经典诗文与传统礼仪 自然科学常识：身边的自然与科学 世界地理人文：山川国家与人文风貌 法治安全通识：规则、法律与安全常识 艺术美育基础：音乐、美术与审美启蒙 贴心分学段 内容分为小学低段（一到三年级）、小学高段（四到六年级）、初中（七到九年级）三个学段，难度循序渐进。高学段可查看低学段的全部内容，温故而知新。 核心功能 知识阅览：纯文字知识点，界面清爽，可收藏、自动记录已读，还能一键跳转到相关习题。 刷题练习：提供分类专项和综合随机两种模式，题量可选十题、二十题或全部，选择即判分并给出详细解析。 错题本：答错的题目自动归档，支持顺序复盘与随机重测，可单条或批量删除。 我的收藏：收藏喜欢的知识点，随时回看。 学习统计：做题次数、正确率、阅读完成度、各板块表现清晰呈现，进步看得见。 阅读设置：支持调整字体大小与浅色深色模式，呵护孩子视力。 安心使用 完全离线运行，无需联网，无需注册登录。 不收集任何个人信息，不含广告，不含内购。 所有学习数据仅保存在本机，可随时清空，家长更放心。 联系我们 应用反馈：欢迎在 App Store 中留下评价和反馈。

6775859441.description: Kvitto is the offline-first point-of-sale, inventory, and invoicing app built for independent shops, market stalls, and small brands anywhere in the world. Everything runs on your device — no internet required, no accounts, and no monthly payment-processor fees. SELL IN SECONDS Scan barcodes straight into the cart for fast checkout Apply discounts, adjust prices, hold orders, and process refunds Show your own payment QR code at checkout — keep 100% of every sale, with no transaction fees KNOW YOUR STOCK Track inventory with automatic low-stock alerts Multi-variant products (size × color) with stock per variant Stock deducts automatically on every sale and is restored on refunds PROFESSIONAL INVOICES Create clean PDF invoices with your logo and signature Manage customers with addresses and VAT / tax numbers Multiple tax rates and tax-inclusive pricing Share by email or messaging in a single tap SEE WHAT SELLS Daily, weekly, and monthly sales dashboard Top products by revenue or quantity Export to CSV or PDF YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE Works 100% offline — keep selling even with no signal All data stays on your device, stored in an encrypted database Optional encrypted backup to your own iCloud Drive or Google Drive No ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking, and no account required Kvitto is free to start. Made for corner shops, boutiques, stationery and gift stores, pop-ups, and cross-border sellers who want a simple, private, and lightweight way to run the shop. 6789276982.name: Faraday Hidden Camera Detector
6789276982.description: Checking into a hotel or Airbnb? Sweep the room in about two minutes before you unpack. Faraday turns your iPhone into a privacy scanner: find hidden cameras, spot Bluetooth trackers that may be following you, and see exactly who's connected to your Wi-Fi. We'll tell you the honest truth up front — no phone can catch everything, and we show you what each scan can and can't detect. That's the difference between Faraday and the apps that overpromise. WHAT FARADAY DOES Hidden Camera Detector — scan your Wi-Fi for connected devices and possible IP cameras, and use your camera to catch tell-tale lens reflections and infrared LEDs. AirTag & Tracker Detector — sweep for nearby Bluetooth trackers and flag the ones that look like they're traveling with you. Who's On My Wi-Fi — see every device on the network, with unknown devices called out. Plus a built-in Wi-Fi safety check and speed test. Continuous Background Monitoring — keep watching your Wi-Fi after you close the app and get an alert when a new device appears. Bug Detector — use the magnetometer to sense magnetic fields from some hidden electronics. Room Sweep Presets — one tap runs the whole sequence for where you are: Hotel, Airbnb, Home or Car. 6763532061.name: 小白学音基
6763532061.description: 「小白学音基」面向刚接触音乐的朋友，把五线谱、节奏、常见术语和简单和声，拆成能跟着练的小单元。你不必先啃厚厚教材，可以从「乐理课堂」按章节读图文讲解，每课都有随堂测，读完立刻检验是否理解；认谱、节奏、音程与和弦等练习则帮助把知识落到谱面上，题目会覆盖高音谱与低音谱等常见情况，循序渐进加难度。 词典里整理了速度与力度等常用演奏术语，支持搜索和分类，遇到陌生意大利文或标记时可以随手查。每日一练把不同题型混在一起，用短时间巩固习惯；错题本会记下薄弱点，学习成就与模拟小测则让你在阶段性自测里看见进步。界面支持字号调节与深色外观，长时间阅读也更舒服。 无论你是准备考级、学乐器还是想听懂乐谱在说什么，都可以用这里的内容搭起第一套框架：先建立谱表与拍子的概念，再认识音程与三和弦的色彩，配合术语与课堂里的力度、速度、反复记号等知识，逐步把「看得懂」变成「反应得过来」。愿这些小块的学习时间，成为你和乐谱、和音乐之间踏实的第一步。

6764157958.name: HangFlow
6764157958.description: HangFlow is a simple hangboard workout companion for iPhone and Apple Watch. Build a hang workout on iPhone, run it on iPhone or Apple Watch, track each completed session in Calendar Archive, and export clean PDFs when you want a record of your training. HangFlow is built for climbers who want a focused hangboard timer without accounts, subscriptions, clutter, or complicated training systems. Features: Build custom hangboard workouts on iPhone Set countdown, hang time, recovery time, repeats, and extra recovery Track grip type, left/right hand finger setup, edge size, resistance band, and added weight Run workouts directly on iPhone Send workouts to Apple Watch Use Apple Watch as the workout runner Mirror Apple Watch workout timing on iPhone Save completed workouts to Calendar Archive View completed sessions by day and time Support multiple completed workouts on the same day Export workout template PDFs Export completed-session PDFs Export selected-day History PDFs Review completed session details after training Calendar Archive: Finished workouts are saved as completed sessions, not just generic workout templates. That means each session keeps its own date, time, source, setup, totals, and block details. PDF Export: Create clean records of saved workout templates, completed sessions, or a full selected training day. Apple Watch: Use Apple Watch as an optional workout runner. The iPhone app still works on its own. Privacy: HangFlow does not require an account. Your workout data stays on your device. Important: HangFlow records your hangboard setup and timing. It does not tell you what grip to use, how hard to train, or whether a workout is safe for you. Use grip positions and loads you already understand, progress gradually, and stop if something feels wrong.

6450638963.name: 城市:天际线我当市长 2023
6450638963.description: 您不仅仅是市政厅的行政长官。将城市的部分区域指定为地区，使政策得以实施，从而使您出人头地，荣登您自创城市的市长宝座。 切身体会到创造和维持一座真正城市的兴奋和艰辛，同时扩展了城市建设体验中的一些经久不衰的主题。 游戏特色： 多层级且极具挑战性的模拟： 从头开始建造您的城市学起来容易，但掌握起来难。在游戏中，作为城市的市长，您将面对平衡各种必要需求的难题，例如教育、水力发电、警察、消防、医疗等等诸多问题，以及您的城市真正的经济体系。您的城市中的居民严肃灵活地对众多游戏场景做出回应，真实感极强。
